```{r}
#| label: step10-helper-result-extraction
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("\n=== SCHRITT 10.1: Helper Functions for Result Extraction ===")

# ============================================================
# Central Helper: Extract standardized results from lm/lmer models
# Purpose: Avoid code duplication, ensure consistent reporting
# ============================================================

extract_model_results <- function(model, term_of_interest = NULL, model_name = "Model") {
  # Extract coefficients with CIs
  coef_table <- broom.mixed::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE)

  # Filter for fixed effects (only for mixed models)
  if ("effect" %in% names(coef_table)) {
    coef_table <- coef_table %>%
      filter(effect == "fixed")
  }

  # Select relevant columns (handle missing 'df' column in some models)
  available_cols <- intersect(
    c("term", "estimate", "std.error", "conf.low", "conf.high", "statistic", "df", "p.value"),
    names(coef_table)
  )
  coef_table <- coef_table %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(available_cols))

  # If specific term requested, filter
  if (!is.null(term_of_interest)) {
    coef_table <- coef_table %>%
      filter(grepl(term_of_interest, term, fixed = FALSE))
  }

  # Add model diagnostics
  n_obs <- nobs(model)

  # VIF if multiple predictors
  vif_vals <- tryCatch(car::vif(model), error = function(e) NULL)

  # Return list with all relevant info
  list(
    coefficients = coef_table,
    n = n_obs,
    vif = vif_vals,
    model_name = model_name
  )
}

# ============================================================
# LOPO Cross-Validation for Model Validation (Issue O.1/O.3)
# Leave-One-Patient-Out CV: Robuste interne Validierung
# Purpose: Echte Generalisierung auf neue Patienten testen
# ============================================================

run_loocv <- function(model_formula, data, model_type = "lmer", id_col = "pid") {
  # Leave-One-Patient-Out Cross-Validation (LOPO)
  # Pro Fold: Ein Patient (alle Zeitpunkte) als Testset
  # Prediction: Fixed effects only (keine patient-spezifischen Random Effects)
  # Returns: RMSE, R², n_valid, n_total, pred_df

  # Extract response variable name from formula
  response_var <- as.character(model_formula)[2]

  # Check if id_col exists
  if (!id_col %in% names(data)) {
    stop(sprintf("id_col '%s' nicht in data gefunden", id_col))
  }

  # Unique patients
  unique_patients <- unique(data[[id_col]])
  n_patients <- length(unique_patients)

  message(sprintf("  Starting LOPO CV: %d patients, %d observations",
                  n_patients, nrow(data)))

  # Initialize storage for predictions
  all_predictions <- data.frame(
    pid = character(),
    row_id = integer(),
    y_true = numeric(),
    y_pred = numeric(),
    fold_id = integer(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  n_folds_valid <- 0
  n_folds_failed <- 0

  # LOPO loop: iterate over patients
  for (fold_idx in seq_along(unique_patients)) {
    patient_id <- unique_patients[fold_idx]

    # Training data: all patients except current one
    train_data <- data[data[[id_col]] != patient_id, ]
    test_data <- data[data[[id_col]] == patient_id, ]

    # Skip if test set is empty
    if (nrow(test_data) == 0) {
      message(sprintf("  ⚠️  Fold %d (pid=%s): Testdaten leer, übersprungen",
                      fold_idx, patient_id))
      n_folds_failed <- n_folds_failed + 1
      next
    }

    # Fit model on training data
    fit_success <- FALSE
    fit_model <- NULL

    if (model_type == "lmer") {
      suppressWarnings({
        tryCatch({
          fit_model <- lmerTest::lmer(
            model_formula,
            data = train_data,
            REML = TRUE,
            control = lme4::lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE)
          )
          fit_success <- TRUE
        }, error = function(e) {
          message(sprintf("  ⚠️  Fold %d (pid=%s): Modell-Fit fehlgeschlagen - %s",
                          fold_idx, patient_id, conditionMessage(e)))
        })
      })
    } else if (model_type == "lm") {
      suppressWarnings({
        tryCatch({
          fit_model <- lm(model_formula, data = train_data)
          fit_success <- TRUE
        }, error = function(e) {
          message(sprintf("  ⚠️  Fold %d (pid=%s): Modell-Fit fehlgeschlagen - %s",
                          fold_idx, patient_id, conditionMessage(e)))
        })
      })
    }

    if (!fit_success || is.null(fit_model)) {
      n_folds_failed <- n_folds_failed + 1
      next
    }

    # Predict on test data (fixed effects only for lmer)
    predictions <- NULL
    suppressWarnings({
      tryCatch({
        if (model_type == "lmer") {
          # Fixed effects only: re.form = NA
          predictions <- predict(
            fit_model,
            newdata = test_data,
            re.form = NA,  # Keine Random Effects
            allow.new.levels = TRUE
          )
        } else if (model_type == "lm") {
          predictions <- predict(fit_model, newdata = test_data)
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        message(sprintf("  ⚠️  Fold %d (pid=%s): Prediction fehlgeschlagen - %s",
                        fold_idx, patient_id, conditionMessage(e)))
      })
    })

    # Check if predictions succeeded
    if (is.null(predictions) || any(is.na(predictions))) {
      message(sprintf("  ⚠️  Fold %d (pid=%s): NA predictions, übersprungen",
                      fold_idx, patient_id))
      n_folds_failed <- n_folds_failed + 1
      next
    }

    # Extract true values
    actuals <- test_data[[response_var]]

    # Store predictions
    fold_predictions <- data.frame(
      pid = as.character(patient_id),
      row_id = which(data[[id_col]] == patient_id),
      y_true = actuals,
      y_pred = predictions,
      fold_id = fold_idx,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    all_predictions <- rbind(all_predictions, fold_predictions)
    n_folds_valid <- n_folds_valid + 1
  }

  # Calculate metrics from all collected predictions
  if (nrow(all_predictions) == 0) {
    message("  ❌ LOPO CV fehlgeschlagen: Keine gültigen Vorhersagen")
    return(list(
      rmse = NA,
      r_squared = NA,
      n_valid = 0,
      n_total = nrow(data),
      n_folds_valid = 0,
      n_folds_total = n_patients,
      pred_df = all_predictions
    ))
  }

  # RMSE
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((all_predictions$y_true - all_predictions$y_pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

  # R² out-of-sample
  ss_res <- sum((all_predictions$y_true - all_predictions$y_pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ss_tot <- sum((all_predictions$y_true - mean(all_predictions$y_true, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  r_squared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)

  message("  ✓ Helper functions loaded")
}
```

## SECONDARY ANALYSIS 1: EF-Effekt auf Inflammation

**Ziel:** Testen, ob Baseline-EF die Inflammationsantwort moduliert

**Methodik:**
- Hierarchisch: erst Interaction, dann Additive Model
- Decision Rules: p < 0.05, VIF < 5, n ≥ 15 per group

```{r}
#| label: step10-secondary-ef-analysis
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: true

message("\n========================================")
message("SECONDARY 1: EF Effect on Inflammation")
message("========================================\n")

# ============================================================
# A) DATENBASIS & VALIDIERUNG
# ============================================================

# Data: alle 3 Zeitpunkte mit EF
ef_data <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V1", "V2")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pr_echo_ef_percent), !is.na(clinical_inflammation_score)) %>%
  mutate(ef_centered = pr_echo_ef_percent - 50) %>%
  droplevels()

message(sprintf("Data: n = %d patients, %d observations",
                n_distinct(ef_data$pid),
                nrow(ef_data)))

# A1) EF-baseline Konstanz-Validierung
# Regel: EF muss pro pid konstant sein (baseline measurement)
ef_validity_check <- ef_data %>%
  group_by(pid) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ef_unique = n_distinct(pr_echo_ef_percent),
    ef_min = min(pr_echo_ef_percent),
    ef_max = max(pr_echo_ef_percent),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ef_offenders <- ef_validity_check %>% filter(n_ef_unique > 1)

if (nrow(ef_offenders) > 0) {
  print(ef_offenders)
  stop("❌ EF validity violation: EF not constant within pid for ",
       nrow(ef_offenders), " patient(s). Check data integrity.")
}

message(sprintf("✓ EF validity: EF constant within pid (n = %d patients checked)",
                nrow(ef_validity_check)))

# ============================================================
# B) LINEARITY-CHECK (Plan-required)
# ============================================================

# B1) Scatterplot: Baseline A only, inflammation_score vs EF
ef_baseline_linearity_data <- ef_data %>% filter(timepoint == "A")

p_linearity <- ggplot(ef_baseline_linearity_data,
                      aes(x = pr_echo_ef_percent, y = clinical_inflammation_score)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "EF Linearity Check at Baseline",
    x = "Baseline EF (%)",
    y = "Inflammation Score (GSVA)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

ggsave(
  file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "Fig_S_EF_linearity_baseline.png"),
  plot = p_linearity,
  width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300
)

message("✓ Saved: Fig_S_EF_linearity_baseline.png")

# ============================================================
# C) MODELL & HIERARCHIE: Interaction Test
# ============================================================

# C1) Fit Interaktionsmodell (REML=FALSE für ANOVA)
ef_interaction_model <- lmerTest::lmer(
  clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint * ef_centered + age + sex + (1|pid),
  data = ef_data,
  REML = FALSE
)

# Type-III ANOVA (Satterthwaite) für timepoint:ef_centered
ef_anova <- anova(ef_interaction_model, type = 3, ddf = "Satterthwaite")
ef_interaction_p <- ef_anova["timepoint:ef_centered", "Pr(>F)"]

# Klassifikation der Interaktion
if (ef_interaction_p < 0.05) {
  interaction_class <- "significant"
} else if (ef_interaction_p >= 0.05 && ef_interaction_p < 0.10) {
  interaction_class <- "suggestive"
} else {
  interaction_class <- "ns"
}

message(sprintf("Interaction (timepoint:ef_centered): p = %.4f [%s]",
                ef_interaction_p, interaction_class))

# ============================================================
# D) VIF-DIAGNOSTIK (rein diagnostisch, keine Auto-Refactoring)
# ============================================================

# D1) VIF berechnen am Interaktionsmodell
ef_vif <- car::vif(ef_interaction_model)
message("\nVIF diagnostics:")
print(ef_vif)

# Extract max VIF (handles both numeric vector and GVIF matrix)
if (is.matrix(ef_vif)) {
  # GVIF case: extract GVIF^(1/(2*Df)) column (standardized)
  max_vif <- max(ef_vif[, "GVIF^(1/(2*Df))"], na.rm = TRUE)
} else {
  max_vif <- max(ef_vif, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# VIF-Interpretation (diagnostisch, keine Modelländerung)
vif_threshold <- 10

if (max_vif > vif_threshold) {
  warning(sprintf("High (G)VIF detected (max = %.2f > %d). Proceeding WITHOUT changing the model. Interpret coefficients with caution.",
                  max_vif, vif_threshold))
  message("  → Multicollinearity present but model retained as specified")
} else if (max_vif > 5) {
  message(sprintf("⚠️ VIF classification: MODERATE (max = %.2f). Caution advised, but acceptable.",
                  max_vif))
} else {
  message(sprintf("✓ VIF diagnostics: OK (max = %.2f, threshold = %d)",
                  max_vif, vif_threshold))
}

# ============================================================
# E & F) HIERARCHISCHE ENTSCHEIDUNGSREGEL
# ============================================================

if (interaction_class %in% c("significant", "suggestive")) {

  # ========== INTERACTION BRANCH: PROBING ==========

  message("\n→ Interaction is notable => Probing contrasts at EF levels")

  # E1a) emmeans contrasts: EF=30% vs EF=60%
  # ef_centered = EF - 50, daher: EF=30 => -20, EF=60 => +10
  ef_emms <- emmeans::emmeans(ef_interaction_model,
                               ~ timepoint | ef_centered,
                               at = list(ef_centered = c(-20, 10)))

  ef_contrasts_by_level <- emmeans::contrast(
    ef_emms,
    list(
      "V1 - A"  = c(-1, 1, 0),
      "V2 - A"  = c(-1, 0, 1),
      "V2 - V1" = c( 0,-1, 1)
    ),
    adjust = "none"
  )

  # Dataframe aufbauen
  ef_contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(summary(ef_contrasts_by_level, infer = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(EF_percent = ef_centered + 50) %>%
    select(EF_percent, contrast, estimate, SE, df, lower.CL, upper.CL, p.value)

  # Export
  write.csv(
    ef_contrasts_df,
    file.path(clinical_output_dir, "secondary_EF_interaction_contrasts_EF30vs60.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  message("✓ Saved: secondary_EF_interaction_contrasts_EF30vs60.csv")

  # E1b) "Per 10% EF" Effekt auf akuten Response (V1-A)
  # Schätze V1-A bei EF=40 und EF=50, berechne Differenz
  ef_emms_acute <- emmeans::emmeans(ef_interaction_model,
                                     ~ timepoint | ef_centered,
                                     at = list(ef_centered = c(-10, 0)))

  ef_contrasts_acute <- emmeans::contrast(
    ef_emms_acute,
    list("V1 - A" = c(-1, 1, 0)),
    adjust = "none"
  )

  acute_response_df <- as.data.frame(summary(ef_contrasts_acute))

  # V1-A @ EF=40 und EF=50
  v1a_at_40 <- acute_response_df$estimate[acute_response_df$ef_centered == -10]
  v1a_at_50 <- acute_response_df$estimate[acute_response_df$ef_centered == 0]

  delta10_acute <- v1a_at_50 - v1a_at_40

  message(sprintf("✓ Per +10%% EF effect on acute response (V1-A): Δ = %.3f",
                  delta10_acute))

  # ========== FIGURE 3 (conditional) ==========

  # F1) Figure 3: nur bei notable interaction
  message("\n→ Creating Figure 3 (conditional visualization)")

  ef_data_fig3 <- ef_data %>%
    mutate(EF_group = if_else(pr_echo_ef_percent >= 50,
                              "Preserved EF (≥50%)",
                              "Reduced EF (<50%)"))

  ef_summary_fig3 <- ef_data_fig3 %>%
    group_by(EF_group, timepoint) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_inflammation = mean(clinical_inflammation_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      se_inflammation = sd(clinical_inflammation_score, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  p_fig3 <- ggplot(ef_summary_fig3,
                   aes(x = timepoint, y = mean_inflammation,
                       color = EF_group, group = EF_group)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_inflammation - se_inflammation,
                      ymax = mean_inflammation + se_inflammation),
                  width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Preserved EF (≥50%)" = "#2E7D32",
                                   "Reduced EF (<50%)" = "#C62828")) +
    labs(
      title = "Inflammation Trajectory by EF Subgroup",
      x = "Timepoint",
      y = "Inflammation Score (GSVA)",
      color = "EF Category"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

  ggsave(
    file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "Fig3_EF_subgroup_trajectory.png"),
    plot = p_fig3,
    width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300
  )

  message("✓ Saved: Fig3_EF_subgroup_trajectory.png (conditional, visual-only)")

} else {

  # ========== ADDITIVE BRANCH ==========

  message("\n→ Interaction ns => Fitting additive model")

  # F1) Additives Modell
  ef_additive_model <- lmerTest::lmer(
    clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint + ef_centered + age + sex + (1|pid),
    data = ef_data,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  # Export fixed effects
  ef_additive_coefs <- broom.mixed::tidy(ef_additive_model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(effect == "fixed")

  write.csv(
    ef_additive_coefs,
    file.path(clinical_output_dir, "secondary_EF_additive_coefficients.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  message("✓ Saved: secondary_EF_additive_coefficients.csv")

  # F2) Report EF main effect per +10% EF
  ef_main_row <- ef_additive_coefs %>% filter(term == "ef_centered")

  if (nrow(ef_main_row) == 1) {
    beta10 <- 10 * ef_main_row$estimate
    ci10_lower <- 10 * ef_main_row$conf.low
    ci10_upper <- 10 * ef_main_row$conf.high
    p_main <- ef_main_row$p.value

    message(sprintf("→ EF main effect per +10%% EF: β = %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f], p = %.4f",
                    beta10, ci10_lower, ci10_upper, p_main))
  }

  message("\n(No Figure 3 created: interaction not notable)")
}

# ============================================================
# FERTIG
# ============================================================

message("\n✓ EF analysis complete (hierarchical, reviewer-proof)\n")
```

## SECONDARY ANALYSIS 2: Myeloid-Lymphoid Ratio

**Ziel:** Validierung der Immunzell-Verschiebung via Deconvolution

**Cross-Method Validation:** CIBERSORT + MCP-counter

```{r}
#| label: step10-secondary-mlr-analysis
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("========================================")
message("SECONDARY 2: Myeloid-Lymphoid Ratio")
message("========================================\n")

# Check if deconvolution data available
# Spaltennamen nach Step 5 Join: CIBERSORT_ prefix, Singular für Mono/Neutro, Aggregate für T/NK
has_cib <- all(c("CIBERSORT_Monocyte", "CIBERSORT_Neutrophil",
                 "CIBERSORT_t_cell_total", "CIBERSORT_nk_cell_total") %in% names(sample_meta_clinical))

if (!has_cib) {
  message("⚠️ SKIPPED: Deconvolution data not available")
  message("  Expected columns: CIBERSORT_Monocyte, CIBERSORT_Neutrophil, CIBERSORT_t_cell_total, CIBERSORT_nk_cell_total")
  message("  Available CIBERSORT columns: ", paste(grep("^CIBERSORT_", names(sample_meta_clinical), value = TRUE), collapse = ", "))
} else {
  # Compute MLR (Plan: log2((Mono+Neut+eps)/(T+NK+eps)), eps=0.01)
  epsilon <- 0.01
  mlr_data <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
    filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V1", "V2")) %>%
    mutate(
      mlr_cibersort = log2((CIBERSORT_Monocyte + CIBERSORT_Neutrophil + epsilon) /
                           (CIBERSORT_t_cell_total + CIBERSORT_nk_cell_total + epsilon))
    )

  # LMM
  mlr_model <- lmerTest::lmer(
    mlr_cibersort ~ timepoint + (1|pid),
    data = mlr_data,
    REML = TRUE
  )

  mlr_anova <- anova(mlr_model, type = 3)
  message(sprintf("MLR Timepoint effect: F = %.2f, p = %.4f",
                  mlr_anova["timepoint", "F value"],
                  mlr_anova["timepoint", "Pr(>F)"]))

  # Contrasts
  mlr_emms <- emmeans::emmeans(mlr_model, ~ timepoint)
  mlr_contrasts <- emmeans::contrast(mlr_emms,
                                     list("V1 - A" = c(-1, 1, 0),
                                          "V2 - A" = c(-1, 0, 1),
                                          "V2 - V1" = c(0, -1, 1)),
                                     adjust = "none")

  message("\nContrasts:")
  mlr_contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(summary(mlr_contrasts))
  print(dplyr::select(mlr_contrasts_df, contrast, estimate, p.value))


  # Save contrasts
  mlr_contrasts_summary <- as.data.frame(summary(mlr_contrasts, infer = TRUE))
  write.csv(mlr_contrasts_summary,
            file.path(clinical_output_dir, "secondary_mlr_contrasts.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)

  # Save EMMs
  mlr_emms_summary <- as.data.frame(summary(mlr_emms, infer = TRUE))
  write.csv(mlr_emms_summary,
            file.path(clinical_output_dir, "secondary_mlr_emms.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)

  # ============================================================
  # Fig S4: MLR Figure (Primary-Style: Violin+Box+Spaghetti+EMM)
  # ============================================================
  message("\nCreating Figure S4 (MLR in Primary style)...")

  # Ensure factor levels
  mlr_data$timepoint <- factor(mlr_data$timepoint, levels = c("A", "V1", "V2"))

  # X-Axis Labels (matching Primary)
  timepoint_labels <- c("A" = "Pre-TAVR", "V1" = "3 days post-TAVR", "V2" = "3 months post-TAVR")

  # Prepare EMM summary for plotting
  mlr_plot_summary <- mlr_emms_summary %>%
    mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("A", "V1", "V2")))

  # Sample sizes per timepoint
  mlr_n_counts <- mlr_data %>%
    group_by(timepoint) %>%
    summarise(n = n_distinct(pid), .groups = "drop")

  n_mlr_A  <- mlr_n_counts$n[mlr_n_counts$timepoint == "A"]
  n_mlr_V1 <- mlr_n_counts$n[mlr_n_counts$timepoint == "V1"]
  n_mlr_V2 <- mlr_n_counts$n[mlr_n_counts$timepoint == "V2"]

  # Create figure (Primary-style)
  p_mlr_figure <- ggplot() +
    # Patient trajectories (spaghetti lines) - background
    geom_line(data = mlr_data,
              aes(x = timepoint, y = mlr_cibersort, group = pid),
              color = "gray80", alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.3) +
    # Individual data points with jitter
    geom_jitter(data = mlr_data,
                aes(x = timepoint, y = mlr_cibersort),
                width = 0.15, alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5, color = "gray50") +
    # Violin plots
    geom_violin(data = mlr_data,
                aes(x = timepoint, y = mlr_cibersort, fill = timepoint),
                alpha = 0.3, trim = TRUE) +
    # Boxplots overlaid
    geom_boxplot(data = mlr_data,
                 aes(x = timepoint, y = mlr_cibersort),
                 width = 0.2, alpha = 0, outlier.shape = NA) +
    # EMM points with 95% CI (red)
    geom_pointrange(data = mlr_plot_summary,
                    aes(x = timepoint, y = emmean,
                        ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                    color = "red", size = 1, linewidth = 1.2) +
    # EMM line connecting timepoints (red)
    geom_line(data = mlr_plot_summary,
              aes(x = as.numeric(timepoint), y = emmean),
              color = "red", linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid") +
    # Styling
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = timepoint_labels) +
    labs(
      x = "Timepoint",
      y = "Myeloid–Lymphoid Ratio (log2 scale)",
      title = "SECONDARY ANALYSIS: Myeloid–Lymphoid Ratio"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    # Add sample sizes below x-axis
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = min(mlr_data$mlr_cibersort, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.5,
             label = sprintf("n = %d", n_mlr_A), size = 3.5) +
    annotate("text", x = 2, y = min(mlr_data$mlr_cibersort, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.5,
             label = sprintf("n = %d", n_mlr_V1), size = 3.5) +
    annotate("text", x = 3, y = min(mlr_data$mlr_cibersort, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.5,
             label = sprintf("n = %d", n_mlr_V2), size = 3.5)

  # Save figure
  ggsave(
    file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "Fig_S4_MLR_timecourse.png"),
    plot = p_mlr_figure,
    width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )
  message("  ✓ Fig S4 saved: Fig_S4_MLR_timecourse.png")

  # Optional: Create caption (similar to Primary)
  # Helper: format p-values
  format_p_mlr <- function(p) {
    if (is.na(p)) return("p = NA")
    if (p < 1e-4) return(sprintf("p < %.1e", 1e-4))
    if (p < 0.001) return("p < 0.001")
    return(sprintf("p = %.3f", p))
  }

  # Extract F-test info
  mlr_f_stat <- mlr_anova["timepoint", "F value"]
  mlr_f_p <- mlr_anova["timepoint", "Pr(>F)"]
  mlr_f_df1 <- mlr_anova["timepoint", "NumDF"]
  mlr_f_df2 <- mlr_anova["timepoint", "DenDF"]

  # Build caption
  mlr_caption_text <- sprintf(
    "Figure S4. Longitudinal changes in Myeloid–Lymphoid Ratio (MLR) across timepoints (Pre-TAVR: n=%d; 3d post-TAVR: n=%d; 3mo post-TAVR: n=%d). MLR = log2((Monocytes + Neutrophils) / (T cells + NK cells)). Linear mixed model: F(%.0f, %.1f) = %.2f, %s. Pairwise contrasts (unadjusted): ",
    n_mlr_A, n_mlr_V1, n_mlr_V2, mlr_f_df1, mlr_f_df2, mlr_f_stat, format_p_mlr(mlr_f_p)
  )

  # Add contrasts to caption
  for (i in 1:nrow(mlr_contrasts_summary)) {
    contr <- mlr_contrasts_summary[i, ]
    mlr_caption_text <- paste0(
      mlr_caption_text,
      sprintf("%s: Δ = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f], %s",
              contr$contrast, contr$estimate, contr$lower.CL, contr$upper.CL,
              format_p_mlr(contr$p.value))
    )
    if (i < nrow(mlr_contrasts_summary)) mlr_caption_text <- paste0(mlr_caption_text, "; ")
  }
  mlr_caption_text <- paste0(mlr_caption_text, ". Data shown: individual patients (gray lines), violin/box plots, and estimated marginal means ± 95% CI (red).")

  # Save caption as TXT
  writeLines(
    mlr_caption_text,
    file.path(clinical_output_dir, "secondary_mlr_figure_caption.txt")
  )
  message("  ✓ Caption saved: secondary_mlr_figure_caption.txt")

  message("\n✓ MLR analysis complete\n")

  # ============================================================
  # MCP-counter Validation (Cross-Method Check)
  # ============================================================
  message("\n========================================")
  message("MCP-counter MLR Validation")
  message("========================================\n")

  # Check MCP columns availability
  has_mcp <- all(c("MCP_Monocyte", "MCP_Neutrophil", "MCP_T_cell", "MCP_NK_cell") %in% names(sample_meta_clinical))

  if (!has_mcp) {
    message("⚠️ MCP-counter validation SKIPPED: Required columns not available")
    message("  Expected: MCP_Monocyte, MCP_Neutrophil, MCP_T_cell, MCP_NK_cell")
    message("  Available MCP columns: ", paste(grep("^MCP_", names(sample_meta_clinical), value = TRUE), collapse = ", "))
  } else {

    # (1) Compute MLR_MCP (same formula as CIBERSORT)
    mlr_data <- mlr_data %>%
      mutate(
        mlr_mcp = log2((MCP_Monocyte + MCP_Neutrophil + epsilon) /
                       (MCP_T_cell + MCP_NK_cell + epsilon))
      )

    message("✓ MLR_MCP computed")

    # (2) Cross-Method Validation: Correlation between CIBERSORT and MCP
    message("\n--- Cross-Method Correlation ---")

    # Overall correlation
    mlr_complete <- mlr_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(mlr_cibersort) & !is.na(mlr_mcp))

    if (nrow(mlr_complete) > 2) {
      cor_overall <- cor.test(mlr_complete$mlr_cibersort, mlr_complete$mlr_mcp, method = "pearson")
      message(sprintf("Overall correlation: r = %.3f, p = %.4f, n = %d",
                      cor_overall$estimate, cor_overall$p.value, nrow(mlr_complete)))

      # Per-timepoint correlation
      cor_by_tp <- mlr_complete %>%
        group_by(timepoint) %>%
        summarise(
          n = n(),
          r = ifelse(n() > 2, cor(mlr_cibersort, mlr_mcp, use = "complete.obs"), NA_real_),
          p_value = ifelse(n() > 2, cor.test(mlr_cibersort, mlr_mcp)$p.value, NA_real_),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      message("\nPer-timepoint correlations:")
      print(cor_by_tp)

      # Combine overall + per-timepoint for export
      cor_summary <- bind_rows(
        tibble(scope = "overall", n = nrow(mlr_complete),
               r = cor_overall$estimate, p_value = cor_overall$p.value),
        cor_by_tp %>% mutate(scope = as.character(timepoint)) %>% dplyr::select(scope, n, r, p_value)
      )

      # Save correlation table
      write.csv(cor_summary,
                file.path(clinical_output_dir, "secondary_mlr_crossmethod_correlation.csv"),
                row.names = FALSE)
      message("  ✓ Saved: secondary_mlr_crossmethod_correlation.csv")

    } else {
      message("⚠️ Insufficient data for correlation (n = ", nrow(mlr_complete), ")")
    }

    # (3) Timepoint Model for MCP (validation of CIBERSORT findings)
    message("\n--- MCP-based Timepoint Model ---")

    mlr_mcp_model <- lmerTest::lmer(
      mlr_mcp ~ timepoint + (1|pid),
      data = mlr_data,
      REML = TRUE
    )

    mlr_mcp_anova <- anova(mlr_mcp_model, type = 3)
    message(sprintf("MLR_MCP Timepoint effect: F = %.2f, p = %.4f",
                    mlr_mcp_anova["timepoint", "F value"],
                    mlr_mcp_anova["timepoint", "Pr(>F)"]))

    # Contrasts (identical to CIBERSORT)
    mlr_mcp_emms <- emmeans::emmeans(mlr_mcp_model, ~ timepoint)
    mlr_mcp_contrasts <- emmeans::contrast(mlr_mcp_emms,
                                           list("V1 - A" = c(-1, 1, 0),
                                                "V2 - A" = c(-1, 0, 1),
                                                "V2 - V1" = c(0, -1, 1)),
                                           adjust = "none")

    message("\nMCP Contrasts:")
    mlr_mcp_contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(summary(mlr_mcp_contrasts))
    print(dplyr::select(mlr_mcp_contrasts_df, contrast, estimate, p.value))

    # Save MCP outputs
    mlr_mcp_contrasts_summary <- as.data.frame(summary(mlr_mcp_contrasts, infer = TRUE))
    write.csv(mlr_mcp_contrasts_summary,
              file.path(clinical_output_dir, "secondary_mlr_mcp_contrasts.csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)
    message("  ✓ Saved: secondary_mlr_mcp_contrasts.csv")

    mlr_mcp_emms_summary <- as.data.frame(summary(mlr_mcp_emms, infer = TRUE))
    write.csv(mlr_mcp_emms_summary,
              file.path(clinical_output_dir, "secondary_mlr_mcp_emms.csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)
    message("  ✓ Saved: secondary_mlr_mcp_emms.csv")

    # (4) Figure S4b: MCP-based MLR (same style as CIBERSORT)
    message("\n--- Creating Figure S4b (MCP-based MLR) ---")

    # Prepare MCP EMM summary for plotting
    mlr_mcp_plot_summary <- mlr_mcp_emms_summary %>%
      mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("A", "V1", "V2")))

    # Create figure (identical style to CIBERSORT figure)
    p_mlr_mcp_figure <- ggplot() +
      # Patient trajectories (spaghetti lines) - background
      geom_line(data = mlr_data,
                aes(x = timepoint, y = mlr_mcp, group = pid),
                color = "gray80", alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.3) +
      # Individual data points with jitter
      geom_jitter(data = mlr_data,
                  aes(x = timepoint, y = mlr_mcp),
                  width = 0.15, alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5, color = "gray50") +
      # Violin plots
      geom_violin(data = mlr_data,
                  aes(x = timepoint, y = mlr_mcp, fill = timepoint),
                  alpha = 0.3, trim = TRUE) +
      # Boxplots overlaid
      geom_boxplot(data = mlr_data,
                   aes(x = timepoint, y = mlr_mcp),
                   width = 0.2, alpha = 0, outlier.shape = NA) +
      # EMM points with 95% CI (red)
      geom_pointrange(data = mlr_mcp_plot_summary,
                      aes(x = timepoint, y = emmean,
                          ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                      color = "red", size = 1, linewidth = 1.2) +
      # EMM line connecting timepoints (red)
      geom_line(data = mlr_mcp_plot_summary,
                aes(x = as.numeric(timepoint), y = emmean),
                color = "red", linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid") +
      # Styling
      scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = timepoint_labels) +
      labs(
        x = "Timepoint",
        y = "Myeloid–Lymphoid Ratio (log2 scale, MCP-counter)",
        title = "VALIDATION: MLR based on MCP-counter"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      ) +
      # Add sample sizes below x-axis (same as CIBERSORT)
      annotate("text", x = 1, y = min(mlr_data$mlr_mcp, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.5,
               label = sprintf("n = %d", n_mlr_A), size = 3.5) +
      annotate("text", x = 2, y = min(mlr_data$mlr_mcp, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.5,
               label = sprintf("n = %d", n_mlr_V1), size = 3.5) +
      annotate("text", x = 3, y = min(mlr_data$mlr_mcp, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.5,
               label = sprintf("n = %d", n_mlr_V2), size = 3.5)

    # Save MCP figure
    ggsave(
      file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "Fig_S4b_MLR_MCP_timecourse.png"),
      plot = p_mlr_mcp_figure,
      width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
    )
    message("  ✓ Saved: Fig_S4b_MLR_MCP_timecourse.png")

    message("\n✓ MCP-counter validation complete\n")
  }
}
```

### Explorative GSVA-MLR Assoziation (A04)

**Ziel:** Explorativer Zusammenhang zwischen GSVA Inflammation Score und MLR

**Status:** Hypothesis-generating, NOT independent validation

```{r}
#| label: step10-secondary-gsva-mlr-assoc
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("========================================")
message("EXPLORATIVE: GSVA-MLR Association")
message("========================================")
message("NOTE: Hypothesis-generating analysis (not independent validation)\n")

# Check prerequisites: GSVA and MLR data available
has_gsva <- "clinical_inflammation_score" %in% names(sample_meta_clinical) &&
            sum(!is.na(sample_meta_clinical$clinical_inflammation_score)) > 0

has_mlr_computed <- exists("mlr_data") &&
                    "mlr_cibersort" %in% names(mlr_data) &&
                    sum(!is.na(mlr_data$mlr_cibersort)) > 0

if (!has_gsva || !has_mlr_computed) {
  message("⚠️ SKIPPED: Insufficient data for GSVA-MLR association")
  message(sprintf("  GSVA available: %s", has_gsva))
  message(sprintf("  MLR computed: %s", has_mlr_computed))
  if (!has_gsva) {
    message("  Reason: GSVA scores not found (check step6-gsva-pathways)")
  }
  if (!has_mlr_computed) {
    message("  Reason: MLR not computed (check deconvolution data)")
  }
} else {

  # Patient-level delta (A → V1) analysis
  message("Method: Patient-level Δ (A→V1) Spearman correlation")

  # Create paired dataset for A and V1
  gsva_mlr_paired <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
    filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V1")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(clinical_inflammation_score)) %>%
    left_join(
      mlr_data %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, mlr_cibersort),
      by = "sample_id"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(mlr_cibersort)) %>%
    dplyr::select(pid, timepoint, clinical_inflammation_score, mlr_cibersort) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = timepoint,
      values_from = c(clinical_inflammation_score, mlr_cibersort),
      names_sep = "_"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(clinical_inflammation_score_A),
           !is.na(clinical_inflammation_score_V1),
           !is.na(mlr_cibersort_A),
           !is.na(mlr_cibersort_V1))

  # Check sufficient paired data
  if (nrow(gsva_mlr_paired) < 10) {
    message(sprintf("⚠️ SKIPPED: Insufficient paired data (n=%d, need ≥10)",
                   nrow(gsva_mlr_paired)))
    message("  Reason: Too few patients with both GSVA and MLR at A and V1")
  } else {

    # Compute deltas
    gsva_mlr_paired <- gsva_mlr_paired %>%
      mutate(
        delta_gsva = clinical_inflammation_score_V1 - clinical_inflammation_score_A,
        delta_mlr = mlr_cibersort_V1 - mlr_cibersort_A
      )

    # Spearman correlation
    spearman_result <- cor.test(
      gsva_mlr_paired$delta_gsva,
      gsva_mlr_paired$delta_mlr,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )

    # Helper: Format p-value in scientific notation
    format_p_sci <- function(p) {
      if (is.na(p)) return("p-value = NA")
      if (p < 2.2e-16) return("p-value < 2.2e-16")
      paste0("p-value = ", format(p, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3))
    }

    # Create results table
    gsva_mlr_assoc_results <- data.frame(
      analysis = "GSVA-MLR Delta Association",
      n_pairs = nrow(gsva_mlr_paired),
      variable_1 = "Δ GSVA Inflammation (V1-A)",
      variable_2 = "Δ MLR (V1-A)",
      correlation_method = "Spearman",
      rho = spearman_result$estimate,
      p_value = spearman_result$p.value,
      note = "Exploratory analysis; hypothesis-generating only"
    )

    # Save results
    write.csv(gsva_mlr_assoc_results,
              file.path(clinical_output_dir, "secondary_gsva_mlr_assoc.csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)

    message(sprintf("  n pairs (A+V1): %d", nrow(gsva_mlr_paired)))
    message(sprintf("  Spearman rho = %.3f", spearman_result$estimate))
    message(sprintf("  %s", format_p_sci(spearman_result$p.value)))
    message(sprintf("  Interpretation: %s",
                   ifelse(spearman_result$p.value < 0.05,
                          "Nominally significant (exploratory)",
                          "Not significant")))

    # Optional: Simple scatterplot (only if ggplot2 theme already defined)
    if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
      tryCatch({
        gsva_mlr_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
          gsva_mlr_paired,
          ggplot2::aes(x = delta_mlr, y = delta_gsva)
        ) +
          ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
          ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkred") +
          ggplot2::labs(
            title = "Explorative GSVA-MLR Association (Δ A→V1)",
            subtitle = sprintf("Spearman rho = %.3f, p = %s (n=%d)",
                              spearman_result$estimate,
                              if (is.na(spearman_result$p.value)) "NA"
                              else if (spearman_result$p.value < 2.2e-16) "< 2.2e-16"
                              else format(spearman_result$p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3),
                              nrow(gsva_mlr_paired)),
            x = "Δ Myeloid-Lymphoid Ratio (V1 - A)",
            y = "Δ GSVA Inflammation Score (V1 - A)"
          ) +
          ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
          ggplot2::theme(
            plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
            plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9, color = "gray40")
          )

        ggplot2::ggsave(
          file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "secondary_gsva_mlr_assoc_plot.pdf"),
          plot = gsva_mlr_plot,
          width = 6, height = 5
        )

        message("  ✓ Plot saved: secondary_gsva_mlr_assoc_plot.pdf")

      }, error = function(e) {
        message("  Note: Plot generation skipped (", e$message, ")")
      })
    }

    message("  ✓ Results saved: secondary_gsva_mlr_assoc.csv")
  }
}

message("\n✓ GSVA-MLR association analysis complete\n")
```

## EXPLORATORY: Baseline-Nierenfunktion (GFR) als Vulnerabilitätsfaktor

**Ziel:** Prüfen, ob Patienten mit eingeschränkter Nierenfunktion eine abweichende Entzündungsantwort zeigen.

**Methodik:** LMM mit Timepoint × GFR-Interaktion, strenge Schwelle p<0.05 (kein Trend).

```{r}
#| label: step10-exploratory-gfr
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("========================================")
message("EXPLORATORY: GFR Effect on Inflammation")
message("========================================\n")

# Data: alle 3 Zeitpunkte mit GFR
gfr_data <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V1", "V2")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gfr_impaired), !is.na(clinical_inflammation_score)) %>%
  droplevels()

gfr_data$timepoint <- factor(gfr_data$timepoint, levels = c("A", "V1", "V2"))

n_gfr_normal <- n_distinct(gfr_data$pid[gfr_data$gfr_impaired == FALSE])
n_gfr_impaired <- n_distinct(gfr_data$pid[gfr_data$gfr_impaired == TRUE])

message(sprintf("Data: n = %d patients (%d GFR normal, %d GFR impaired), %d observations",
                n_distinct(gfr_data$pid), n_gfr_normal, n_gfr_impaired, nrow(gfr_data)))

# Stop-Regel: n >= 15 pro Gruppe
if (min(n_gfr_normal, n_gfr_impaired) < clinical_params$min_n_per_group) {
  message(sprintf("⚠️ SKIPPED: One GFR group has n < %d (normal=%d, impaired=%d)",
                  clinical_params$min_n_per_group, n_gfr_normal, n_gfr_impaired))
} else {

  # Interaktionsmodell: score ~ timepoint * gfr_impaired + age + (1|pid)
  # Keine zusätzliche Kovariate sex (Modell einfach halten, per Plan)
  gfr_interaction_model <- lmerTest::lmer(
    clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint * gfr_impaired + age + (1|pid),
    data = gfr_data,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  gfr_anova <- anova(gfr_interaction_model, type = 3, ddf = "Satterthwaite")

  # Interaktionstest (streng: nur p<0.05, kein Trend)
  gfr_interaction_p <- gfr_anova["timepoint:gfr_impaired", "Pr(>F)"]
  message(sprintf("Interaction (timepoint:GFR): p = %.4f", gfr_interaction_p))

  if (gfr_interaction_p < 0.05) {
    message("→ Interaction significant: probing interaction")
    # Hier wuerde man emmeans aufschluesseln — bei Signifikanz
    gfr_final_model <- gfr_interaction_model
    gfr_model_type <- "interaction"
  } else {
    message("→ Interaction ns: fitting additive model")

    gfr_additive_model <- lmerTest::lmer(
      clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint + gfr_impaired + age + (1|pid),
      data = gfr_data,
      REML = FALSE
    )

    gfr_final_model <- gfr_additive_model
    gfr_model_type <- "additive"
  }

  # Export fixed effects
  gfr_coefs <- broom.mixed::tidy(gfr_final_model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(effect == "fixed")

  write.csv(
    gfr_coefs,
    file.path(clinical_output_dir, "exploratory_GFR_coefficients.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Report GFR main effect
  gfr_row <- gfr_coefs %>% filter(grepl("gfr_impaired", term))
  if (nrow(gfr_row) == 1) {
    message(sprintf("→ GFR effect (impaired vs normal): β = %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f], p = %.4f",
                    gfr_row$estimate, gfr_row$conf.low, gfr_row$conf.high, gfr_row$p.value))
  }

  message(sprintf("✓ Saved: exploratory_GFR_coefficients.csv (model type: %s)", gfr_model_type))

  # ============================================================
  # SENSITIVITÄT: Kontinuierliche GFR (zusätzlich zur binären)
  # ============================================================
  message("\n--- Sensitivitätsanalyse: Kontinuierliche GFR ---")

  # Prüfe ob kontinuierliche GFR-Variable vorhanden
  if (!"pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd" %in% names(gfr_data)) {
    message("⚠️ Kontinuierliche GFR (pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd) nicht verfügbar")
  } else {

    # Filter: nur Fälle mit valider kontinuierlicher GFR
    gfr_cont_data <- gfr_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd))

    if (nrow(gfr_cont_data) < 30) {
      message(sprintf("⚠️ SKIPPED: Zu wenige Beobachtungen mit GFR-Wert (n=%d)", nrow(gfr_cont_data)))
    } else {

      # Zentriere GFR am Mittelwert (interpretierbarkeit + numerische Stabilität)
      gfr_mean <- mean(gfr_cont_data$pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd, na.rm = TRUE)
      gfr_cont_data <- gfr_cont_data %>%
        mutate(gfr_cont_centered = pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd - gfr_mean)

      message(sprintf("GFR zentriert am Mittelwert: %.1f ml/min/1.73m²", gfr_mean))
      message(sprintf("Daten: n = %d Patienten, %d Beobachtungen",
                      n_distinct(gfr_cont_data$pid), nrow(gfr_cont_data)))

      # Additives Modell (Interaktion bereits mit binär getestet und ns)
      # score ~ timepoint + gfr_cont_centered + age + (1|pid)
      gfr_cont_model <- lmerTest::lmer(
        clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint + gfr_cont_centered + age + (1|pid),
        data = gfr_cont_data,
        REML = FALSE
      )

      # Exportiere Fixed Effects mit 95% CI
      gfr_cont_coefs <- broom.mixed::tidy(gfr_cont_model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
        filter(effect == "fixed")

      write.csv(
        gfr_cont_coefs,
        file.path(clinical_output_dir, "exploratory_GFR_continuous_coefficients.csv"),
        row.names = FALSE
      )

      # Berichte Effekt pro +10 ml/min (klinisch relevantere Einheit)
      gfr_cont_row <- gfr_cont_coefs %>% filter(term == "gfr_cont_centered")

      if (nrow(gfr_cont_row) == 1) {
        beta_per_1 <- gfr_cont_row$estimate
        beta_per_10 <- 10 * beta_per_1
        ci_low_per_10 <- 10 * gfr_cont_row$conf.low
        ci_high_per_10 <- 10 * gfr_cont_row$conf.high
        p_val <- gfr_cont_row$p.value

        message(sprintf("→ Kontinuierlicher GFR-Effekt (pro +10 ml/min): β₁₀ = %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f], p = %.4f",
                        beta_per_10, ci_low_per_10, ci_high_per_10, p_val))
      }

      message("✓ Saved: exploratory_GFR_continuous_coefficients.csv")
    }
  }

  # ============================================================
  # EXPLORATIV: GFR und Recovery (V1 → V2)
  # ============================================================
  message("\n--- Explorative Analyse: GFR-assoziierte Recovery (V1→V2) ---")
  message("Fragestellung: Zeigen Patienten mit schlechterer Nierenfunktion weniger Erholung?")

  # Patient-level Paired Dataset (V1 und V2)
  recovery_data <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
    filter(timepoint %in% c("V1", "V2")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(clinical_inflammation_score)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gfr_impaired)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(age)) %>%
    dplyr::select(pid, timepoint, clinical_inflammation_score, pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd, gfr_impaired, age) %>%
    # Pivot wider: eine Zeile pro Patient mit V1 und V2 Spalten
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = timepoint,
      values_from = clinical_inflammation_score,
      names_prefix = "score_"
    ) %>%
    # Nur komplette Paare behalten
    filter(!is.na(score_V1) & !is.na(score_V2))

  n_pairs_V1_V2 <- nrow(recovery_data)

  if (n_pairs_V1_V2 < 10) {
    message(sprintf("⚠️ SKIPPED: Zu wenige gepaarte Fälle V1-V2 (n=%d, benötigt ≥10)", n_pairs_V1_V2))
  } else {

    # Recovery Delta: V2 - V1 (negativ = Erholung, positiv = Persistenz/Verschlechterung)
    recovery_data <- recovery_data %>%
      mutate(delta_rec = score_V2 - score_V1)

    message(sprintf("Daten: n = %d gepaarte Fälle (V1+V2 komplett)", n_pairs_V1_V2))

    # ----------------
    # Modell 1: Kontinuierliche GFR
    # ----------------
    # Zentriere GFR
    gfr_recovery_mean <- mean(recovery_data$pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd, na.rm = TRUE)
    recovery_data <- recovery_data %>%
      mutate(gfr_cont_centered = pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd - gfr_recovery_mean)

    # Patient-level lm (kein mixed model, da Delta bereits within-patient)
    recovery_cont_model <- lm(
      delta_rec ~ gfr_cont_centered + age,
      data = recovery_data
    )

    # Tidy output mit CI
    recovery_cont_coefs <- broom::tidy(recovery_cont_model, conf.int = TRUE)

    # Export
    write.csv(
      recovery_cont_coefs,
      file.path(clinical_output_dir, "exploratory_GFR_recovery_V2_minus_V1_continuous.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    # Effekt pro +10 ml/min
    gfr_cont_rec_row <- recovery_cont_coefs %>% filter(term == "gfr_cont_centered")

    if (nrow(gfr_cont_rec_row) == 1) {
      beta_per_1_rec <- gfr_cont_rec_row$estimate
      beta_per_10_rec <- 10 * beta_per_1_rec
      ci_low_10_rec <- 10 * gfr_cont_rec_row$conf.low
      ci_high_10_rec <- 10 * gfr_cont_rec_row$conf.high
      p_cont_rec <- gfr_cont_rec_row$p.value

      message(sprintf("→ Kontinuierliche GFR (pro +10 ml/min): β₁₀ = %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f], p = %.4f",
                      beta_per_10_rec, ci_low_10_rec, ci_high_10_rec, p_cont_rec))
      message("   (Da Δ = V2 − V1 gilt: negativer β₁₀ würde bedeuten: höhere GFR → stärkere Erholung; positiver β₁₀: höhere GFR → weniger Erholung.)")
    } else {
      beta_per_10_rec <- NA
      ci_low_10_rec <- NA
      ci_high_10_rec <- NA
      p_cont_rec <- NA
    }

    # ----------------
    # Modell 2: Binäre GFR
    # ----------------
    recovery_binary_model <- lm(
      delta_rec ~ gfr_impaired + age,
      data = recovery_data
    )

    # Tidy output mit CI
    recovery_binary_coefs <- broom::tidy(recovery_binary_model, conf.int = TRUE)

    # Export
    write.csv(
      recovery_binary_coefs,
      file.path(clinical_output_dir, "exploratory_GFR_recovery_V2_minus_V1_binary.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    # Effekt impaired vs normal
    gfr_binary_rec_row <- recovery_binary_coefs %>% filter(grepl("gfr_impaired", term))

    if (nrow(gfr_binary_rec_row) == 1) {
      beta_binary_rec <- gfr_binary_rec_row$estimate
      ci_low_binary_rec <- gfr_binary_rec_row$conf.low
      ci_high_binary_rec <- gfr_binary_rec_row$conf.high
      p_binary_rec <- gfr_binary_rec_row$p.value

      message(sprintf("→ Binäre GFR (impaired vs normal): β = %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f], p = %.4f",
                      beta_binary_rec, ci_low_binary_rec, ci_high_binary_rec, p_binary_rec))
      message("   (Da Δ = V2 − V1 gilt: positiver β würde bedeuten: impaired → weniger Erholung; negativer β: impaired → mehr Erholung.)")
    } else {
      beta_binary_rec <- NA
      ci_low_binary_rec <- NA
      ci_high_binary_rec <- NA
      p_binary_rec <- NA
    }

    # ----------------
    # Summary Table (Eine Zeile)
    # ----------------
    recovery_summary <- data.frame(
      n_pairs = n_pairs_V1_V2,
      beta10_cont = beta_per_10_rec,
      CI_low_cont = ci_low_10_rec,
      CI_high_cont = ci_high_10_rec,
      p_cont = p_cont_rec,
      beta_binary = beta_binary_rec,
      CI_low_binary = ci_low_binary_rec,
      CI_high_binary = ci_high_binary_rec,
      p_binary = p_binary_rec
    )

    write.csv(
      recovery_summary,
      file.path(clinical_output_dir, "exploratory_GFR_recovery_V2_minus_V1_summary.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    message("✓ Saved: exploratory_GFR_recovery_V2_minus_V1_continuous.csv")
    message("✓ Saved: exploratory_GFR_recovery_V2_minus_V1_binary.csv")
    message("✓ Saved: exploratory_GFR_recovery_V2_minus_V1_summary.csv")

    # ----------------
    # Optional: Scatter-Plot
    # ----------------
    if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
      tryCatch({
        p_recovery_scatter <- ggplot(recovery_data, aes(x = pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd, y = delta_rec)) +
          geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5) +
          geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue") +
          geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
          labs(
            title = "GFR and Inflammation Recovery (V1 → V2)",
            subtitle = sprintf("n = %d paired cases; Δ Inflammation = V2 − V1", n_pairs_V1_V2),
            x = "Baseline GFR (ml/min/1.73m²)",
            y = "Δ Inflammation Score (V2 − V1)\n← Recovery | Persistence →"
          ) +
          theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
          theme(
            plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray40", hjust = 0.5),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
          )

        ggsave(
          file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "Fig_S_GFR_recovery_delta_V2_minus_V1.png"),
          plot = p_recovery_scatter,
          width = 7, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
        )

        message("✓ Saved: Fig_S_GFR_recovery_delta_V2_minus_V1.png")

      }, error = function(e) {
        message("  Note: Plot generation skipped (", e$message, ")")
      })
    }

  }

  # ============================================================
  # EXPLORATIV: GFR-Assoziation bei Baseline (nur Zeitpunkt A)
  # ============================================================
  message("\n--- Baseline-Analyse: GFR und Inflammation (Pre-TAVR, A) ---")
  message("Fragestellung: Haben Patienten mit schlechterer Nierenfunktion bereits präprozedural höhere Inflammationsscores?")

  # Baseline-Dataset (nur Zeitpunkt A)
  gfr_baseline <- gfr_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(timepoint == "A")

  # Enforce uniqueness: ein Patient sollte nur einmal bei A vorkommen
  if (any(duplicated(gfr_baseline$pid))) {
    gfr_baseline <- gfr_baseline %>%
      distinct(pid, .keep_all = TRUE)
    message("⚠️ Duplikate bei Zeitpunkt A entfernt (distinct by pid)")
  }

  # Stopp-Regel: mindestens 10 Patienten
  n_baseline <- nrow(gfr_baseline)

  if (n_baseline < 10) {
    message(sprintf("⚠️ SKIPPED: Zu wenige Baseline-Fälle (n=%d, benötigt ≥10)", n_baseline))
  } else {

    # Diagnostics
    message(sprintf("Daten: n = %d Patienten bei Baseline (A)", n_baseline))

    # ----------------
    # Modell 1: Binäre GFR
    # ----------------
    baseline_binary_model <- lm(
      clinical_inflammation_score ~ gfr_impaired + age,
      data = gfr_baseline
    )

    # Tidy output mit CI
    baseline_binary_coefs <- broom::tidy(baseline_binary_model, conf.int = TRUE)

    # Export
    write.csv(
      baseline_binary_coefs,
      file.path(clinical_output_dir, "exploratory_GFR_baseline_A_binary.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    # Effekt impaired vs normal
    baseline_gfr_binary_row <- baseline_binary_coefs %>% filter(grepl("gfr_impaired", term))

    if (nrow(baseline_gfr_binary_row) == 1) {
      beta_baseline_binary <- baseline_gfr_binary_row$estimate
      ci_low_baseline_binary <- baseline_gfr_binary_row$conf.low
      ci_high_baseline_binary <- baseline_gfr_binary_row$conf.high
      p_baseline_binary <- baseline_gfr_binary_row$p.value

      # Format p-value (scientific if very small)
      p_formatted_binary <- if (is.na(p_baseline_binary)) {
        "NA"
      } else if (p_baseline_binary < 1e-4) {
        format(p_baseline_binary, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
      } else {
        sprintf("%.4f", p_baseline_binary)
      }

      message(sprintf("→ Binäre GFR (impaired vs normal): β = %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f], p = %s",
                      beta_baseline_binary, ci_low_baseline_binary, ci_high_baseline_binary, p_formatted_binary))
    }

    message("✓ Saved: exploratory_GFR_baseline_A_binary.csv")

    # ----------------
    # Modell 2: Kontinuierliche GFR
    # ----------------
    # Zentriere GFR am Baseline-Mittelwert
    gfr_baseline_mean <- mean(gfr_baseline$pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd, na.rm = TRUE)
    gfr_baseline <- gfr_baseline %>%
      mutate(gfr_cont_centered = pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd - gfr_baseline_mean)

    baseline_cont_model <- lm(
      clinical_inflammation_score ~ gfr_cont_centered + age,
      data = gfr_baseline
    )

    # Tidy output mit CI
    baseline_cont_coefs <- broom::tidy(baseline_cont_model, conf.int = TRUE)

    # Export
    write.csv(
      baseline_cont_coefs,
      file.path(clinical_output_dir, "exploratory_GFR_baseline_A_continuous.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    # Effekt pro +10 ml/min
    baseline_gfr_cont_row <- baseline_cont_coefs %>% filter(term == "gfr_cont_centered")

    if (nrow(baseline_gfr_cont_row) == 1) {
      beta_per_1_baseline <- baseline_gfr_cont_row$estimate
      beta_per_10_baseline <- 10 * beta_per_1_baseline
      ci_low_10_baseline <- 10 * baseline_gfr_cont_row$conf.low
      ci_high_10_baseline <- 10 * baseline_gfr_cont_row$conf.high
      p_baseline_cont <- baseline_gfr_cont_row$p.value

      # Format p-value (scientific if very small)
      p_formatted_cont <- if (is.na(p_baseline_cont)) {
        "NA"
      } else if (p_baseline_cont < 1e-4) {
        format(p_baseline_cont, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
      } else {
        sprintf("%.4f", p_baseline_cont)
      }

      message(sprintf("→ Kontinuierliche GFR (pro +10 ml/min): β₁₀ = %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f], p = %s",
                      beta_per_10_baseline, ci_low_10_baseline, ci_high_10_baseline, p_formatted_cont))
    }

    message("✓ Saved: exploratory_GFR_baseline_A_continuous.csv")

    # ----------------
    # Optional: Scatter-Plot bei Baseline
    # ----------------
    if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
      tryCatch({
        p_baseline_scatter <- ggplot(gfr_baseline, aes(x = pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd, y = clinical_inflammation_score)) +
          geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue") +
          geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
          labs(
            title = "Baseline GFR and Inflammation Score (Pre-TAVR)",
            subtitle = sprintf("n = %d patients at baseline (A)", n_baseline),
            x = "Baseline GFR (ml/min/1.73m²)",
            y = "GSVA Inflammation Score"
          ) +
          theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
          theme(
            plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray40", hjust = 0.5),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
          )

        ggsave(
          file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "Fig_S_GFR_baseline_scatter_A.png"),
          plot = p_baseline_scatter,
          width = 7, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
        )

        message("✓ Saved: Fig_S_GFR_baseline_scatter_A.png")

      }, error = function(e) {
        message("  Note: Plot generation skipped (", e$message, ")")
      })
    }

  }
}

message("\n✓ GFR analysis complete\n")
```

## EXPLORATORY: Klappentyp (BEV vs SEV) und prozedurale Unterschiede

**Ziel:** Prüfen, ob der Klappentyp den Entzündungsverlauf beeinflusst.

**Methodik:** LMM mit Timepoint × ValveType-Interaktion, keine zusätzlichen Kovariaten.

```{r}
#| label: step10-exploratory-valvetype
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("========================================")
message("EXPLORATORY: ValveType Effect on Inflammation")
message("========================================\n")

# Data: alle 3 Zeitpunkte mit valve_type_grouped
valve_data <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V1", "V2")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(valve_type_grouped), !is.na(clinical_inflammation_score)) %>%
  droplevels()

valve_data$timepoint <- factor(valve_data$timepoint, levels = c("A", "V1", "V2"))

n_bev <- n_distinct(valve_data$pid[valve_data$valve_type_grouped == "BEV"])
n_sev <- n_distinct(valve_data$pid[valve_data$valve_type_grouped == "SEV"])

message(sprintf("Data: n = %d patients (BEV=%d, SEV=%d), %d observations",
                n_distinct(valve_data$pid), n_bev, n_sev, nrow(valve_data)))

# Stop-Regel: n >= 15 pro Gruppe
if (min(n_bev, n_sev) < clinical_params$min_n_per_group) {
  message(sprintf("⚠️ SKIPPED: One valve group has n < %d (BEV=%d, SEV=%d)",
                  clinical_params$min_n_per_group, n_bev, n_sev))
} else {

  # Interaktionsmodell: score ~ timepoint * valve_type_grouped + (1|pid)
  # Keine zusätzlichen Kovariaten (Plan: Modell einfach halten)
  valve_interaction_model <- lmerTest::lmer(
    clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint * valve_type_grouped + (1|pid),
    data = valve_data,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  valve_anova <- anova(valve_interaction_model, type = 3, ddf = "Satterthwaite")

  # Interaktionstest
  valve_interaction_row <- grep("timepoint:valve_type_grouped", rownames(valve_anova))
  valve_interaction_p <- valve_anova[valve_interaction_row, "Pr(>F)"]

  message(sprintf("Interaction (timepoint:ValveType): p = %.4f", valve_interaction_p))

  # Haupteffekt
  valve_main_row <- grep("^valve_type_grouped", rownames(valve_anova))
  valve_main_p <- valve_anova[valve_main_row, "Pr(>F)"]
  message(sprintf("Main effect (ValveType): p = %.4f", valve_main_p))

  if (valve_interaction_p < 0.05) {
    message("→ Interaction significant")
    valve_model_type <- "interaction"
  } else {
    message("→ Interaction ns: checking main effect only")

    # Additives Modell
    valve_additive_model <- lmerTest::lmer(
      clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint + valve_type_grouped + (1|pid),
      data = valve_data,
      REML = FALSE
    )

    valve_model_type <- "additive"
  }

  # Report: kein separater Output per Plan (negative Ergebnisse nur kurz im Text)
  message(sprintf("→ Result: No significant valve type effect (interaction p=%.3f, main p=%.3f)",
                  valve_interaction_p, valve_main_p))
  message("  (Per plan: negative result reported briefly in text, no separate figure)")

  # ============================================================
  # SENSITIVITÄT: Patient-level Δ(V1−A) Vergleich BEV vs SEV
  # ============================================================
  message("\n--- Sensitivitätsanalyse: Δ(V1−A) nach Klappentyp ---")

  # Paired A/V1 Dataset erstellen
  valve_delta_data <- valve_data %>%
    filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V1")) %>%
    dplyr::select(pid, timepoint, clinical_inflammation_score, valve_type_grouped) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = timepoint,
      values_from = clinical_inflammation_score,
      names_prefix = "inflammation_"
    ) %>%
    # Nur komplette Paare behalten
    filter(!is.na(inflammation_A) & !is.na(inflammation_V1)) %>%
    # Delta berechnen
    mutate(delta_V1_A = inflammation_V1 - inflammation_A)

  n_paired_total <- nrow(valve_delta_data)
  n_paired_bev <- sum(valve_delta_data$valve_type_grouped == "BEV", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_paired_sev <- sum(valve_delta_data$valve_type_grouped == "SEV", na.rm = TRUE)

  message(sprintf("Gepaarte Fälle (A+V1): n = %d gesamt (BEV=%d, SEV=%d)",
                  n_paired_total, n_paired_bev, n_paired_sev))

  if (n_paired_total < 10 || min(n_paired_bev, n_paired_sev) < 5) {
    message("⚠️ SKIPPED: Zu wenige gepaarte Fälle für Delta-Analyse")
  } else {

    # Zusammenfassung nach Gruppe
    delta_summary_by_group <- valve_delta_data %>%
      group_by(valve_type_grouped) %>%
      summarise(
        n = n(),
        mean_delta = mean(delta_V1_A, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_delta = median(delta_V1_A, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_delta = sd(delta_V1_A, na.rm = TRUE),
        q25 = quantile(delta_V1_A, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        q75 = quantile(delta_V1_A, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    message("\nGruppenzusammenfassung (Δ = V1 − A):")
    print(delta_summary_by_group)

    # Wilcoxon rank-sum test (robust, non-parametric)
    wilcox_result <- wilcox.test(
      delta_V1_A ~ valve_type_grouped,
      data = valve_delta_data,
      exact = FALSE
    )

    message(sprintf("\nWilcoxon rank-sum test: p = %.4f", wilcox_result$p.value))

    # Gruppenmittelwert-Differenz (BEV - SEV)
    mean_delta_bev <- delta_summary_by_group$mean_delta[delta_summary_by_group$valve_type_grouped == "BEV"]
    mean_delta_sev <- delta_summary_by_group$mean_delta[delta_summary_by_group$valve_type_grouped == "SEV"]
    mean_diff <- mean_delta_bev - mean_delta_sev

    message(sprintf("Mittlere Δ-Differenz (BEV − SEV): %.3f", mean_diff))

    # ----------------
    # CSV Export: Patient-level data
    # ----------------
    write.csv(
      valve_delta_data,
      file.path(clinical_output_dir, "secondary_valvetype_deltaV1A.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    message("✓ Saved: secondary_valvetype_deltaV1A.csv")

    # ----------------
    # TXT Summary Export
    # ----------------
    summary_text <- c(
      "SECONDARY ANALYSIS: Valve Type and Inflammation Change (Δ V1−A)",
      "================================================================",
      "",
      sprintf("Sample size: n = %d paired cases (A+V1)", n_paired_total),
      sprintf("  BEV: n = %d", n_paired_bev),
      sprintf("  SEV: n = %d", n_paired_sev),
      "",
      "Group summaries (Δ Inflammation = V1 − A):",
      sprintf("  BEV: mean = %.3f, median = %.3f, SD = %.3f",
              mean_delta_bev,
              delta_summary_by_group$median_delta[delta_summary_by_group$valve_type_grouped == "BEV"],
              delta_summary_by_group$sd_delta[delta_summary_by_group$valve_type_grouped == "BEV"]),
      sprintf("  SEV: mean = %.3f, median = %.3f, SD = %.3f",
              mean_delta_sev,
              delta_summary_by_group$median_delta[delta_summary_by_group$valve_type_grouped == "SEV"],
              delta_summary_by_group$sd_delta[delta_summary_by_group$valve_type_grouped == "SEV"]),
      "",
      sprintf("Mean difference (BEV − SEV): %.3f", mean_diff),
      "",
      sprintf("Wilcoxon rank-sum test: p = %.4f", wilcox_result$p.value),
      "",
      "Interpretation: Exploratory sensitivity analysis (hypothesis-generating)"
    )

    writeLines(
      summary_text,
      file.path(clinical_output_dir, "secondary_valvetype_deltaV1A_summary.txt")
    )
    message("✓ Saved: secondary_valvetype_deltaV1A_summary.txt")

    # ----------------
    # Plot: Delta Distribution (Option A - violin + box + jitter)
    # ----------------
    if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
      tryCatch({

        # Gruppenmittelwerte für Overlay
        group_means <- delta_summary_by_group %>%
          dplyr::select(valve_type_grouped, mean_delta)

        p_valve_delta <- ggplot(valve_delta_data, aes(x = valve_type_grouped, y = delta_V1_A, fill = valve_type_grouped)) +
          # Violin plots
          geom_violin(alpha = 0.3, trim = TRUE) +
          # Boxplots overlaid
          geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0, outlier.shape = NA) +
          # Individual points with jitter
          geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 2, color = "gray30") +
          # Horizontal line at zero (reference: no change)
          geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5) +
          # Group means (red points)
          geom_point(data = group_means,
                     aes(x = valve_type_grouped, y = mean_delta),
                     color = "red", size = 4, shape = 18) +
          # Styling
          scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
          labs(
            title = "Inflammation Change by Valve Type (A → V1)",
            subtitle = sprintf("BEV: n=%d, SEV: n=%d; Wilcoxon p = %.4f",
                              n_paired_bev, n_paired_sev, wilcox_result$p.value),
            x = "Valve Type",
            y = "Δ Inflammation Score (V1 − A)\n← Recovery | Increase →"
          ) +
          theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
          theme(
            plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray40", hjust = 0.5),
            legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
          )

        ggsave(
          file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "Fig_S_valvetype_deltaV1A.png"),
          plot = p_valve_delta,
          width = 6, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
        )

        message("✓ Saved: Fig_S_valvetype_deltaV1A.png")

      }, error = function(e) {
        message("  Note: Plot generation skipped (", e$message, ")")
      })
    }

  }
}

message("\n✓ Valve type analysis complete\n")
```

## SECONDARY: Metabolic Risk Score als fokussierter klinischer Modifier

**Fragestellung:** Ist ein konservativ definierter kardio-metabolischer Burden (metabolic_risk_score, 0-4: Diabetes, Dyslipidaemie, Hypertonie, BMI>=30; in Step 2 definiert) mit dem Inflammationsniveau longitudinal assoziiert?

**Rahmung:** Fokussierte Secondary-Analyse mit einem vorab definierten Composite; kein Screening. Ein einzelner Test (metabolic_risk_score) bei alpha=0.05.

```{r}
#| label: step10-secondary-metabolicrisk
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# ============================================================
# SECONDARY: metabolic_risk_score as focused clinical modifier
# ============================================================
# Model: clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint + metabolic_risk_score + age + sex + (1|pid)
# Fallback (VIF/convergence): drop age + sex
# One focused test → alpha = 0.05 (no additional screening)
# ============================================================

message("\n========================================")
message("SECONDARY: Metabolic Risk Score Modifier")
message("========================================\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PREREQUISITE CHECKS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("sample_meta_clinical")) {
  stop("FEHLER: sample_meta_clinical nicht gefunden.")
}

metab_required <- c("pid", "timepoint", "clinical_inflammation_score", "metabolic_risk_score", "age", "sex")
metab_missing <- setdiff(metab_required, names(sample_meta_clinical))
if ("metabolic_risk_score" %in% metab_missing) {
  stop("FEHLER: metabolic_risk_score fehlt in sample_meta_clinical. Bitte Schritt 2 (Variable Engineering) ausfuehren.")
}
if (length(metab_missing) > 0) {
  stop("FEHLER: Fehlende Spalten: ", paste(metab_missing, collapse = ", "))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DATA PREPARATION
# ------------------------------------------------------------
metab_data <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V1", "V2")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(clinical_inflammation_score),
         !is.na(metabolic_risk_score)) %>%
  droplevels()

metab_data$timepoint <- factor(metab_data$timepoint, levels = c("A", "V1", "V2"))

if (!identical(levels(metab_data$timepoint), c("A", "V1", "V2"))) {
  stop("FEHLER: timepoint levels nicht exakt c('A','V1','V2').")
}

n_patients_metab <- n_distinct(metab_data$pid)
n_obs_metab <- nrow(metab_data)
message(sprintf("  Data: n_patients = %d, n_obs = %d", n_patients_metab, n_obs_metab))
message(sprintf("  metabolic_risk_score range: %d - %d (mean = %.2f)",
                min(metab_data$metabolic_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE),
                max(metab_data$metabolic_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE),
                mean(metab_data$metabolic_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE)))

# Score distribution (patient-level)
score_dist <- metab_data %>%
  distinct(pid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::count(metabolic_risk_score)
message("  Score distribution (patient-level):")
for (i in 1:nrow(score_dist)) {
  message(sprintf("    Score %d: n = %d", score_dist$metabolic_risk_score[i], score_dist$n[i]))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# MODEL FIT (full model first, fallback if needed)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
model_used <- "full"
has_covariates <- !any(is.na(metab_data$age)) && !any(is.na(metab_data$sex))

if (has_covariates) {
  metab_model <- tryCatch({
    lmerTest::lmer(
      clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint + metabolic_risk_score + age + sex + (1 | pid),
      data = metab_data,
      REML = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("  Full model failed: ", e$message)
    NULL
  })

  # VIF check — if problematic, fall back
  if (!is.null(metab_model)) {
    metab_vif <- tryCatch(car::vif(metab_model), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(metab_vif) && max(metab_vif) > 10) {
      message(sprintf("  VIF > 10 (max = %.2f) — falling back to reduced model", max(metab_vif)))
      metab_model <- NULL
    }
  }
} else {
  metab_model <- NULL
}

# Fallback: reduced model without age+sex
if (is.null(metab_model)) {
  model_used <- "reduced (no age/sex)"
  message("  Fitting reduced model (timepoint + metabolic_risk_score only)")
  metab_model <- lmerTest::lmer(
    clinical_inflammation_score ~ timepoint + metabolic_risk_score + (1 | pid),
    data = metab_data,
    REML = FALSE
  )
}

message(sprintf("  Model used: %s", model_used))

# Singularity check
metab_singular <- lme4::isSingular(metab_model, tol = 1e-4)
if (metab_singular) {
  warning("metabolic_risk model is singular — interpret with caution")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# TYPE-III ANOVA
# ------------------------------------------------------------
metab_anova <- anova(metab_model, type = 3)

message("\n  Type-III ANOVA:")
for (term_name in rownames(metab_anova)) {
  message(sprintf("    %s: F(%.0f, %.1f) = %.2f, p = %.4f",
                  term_name,
                  metab_anova[term_name, "NumDF"],
                  metab_anova[term_name, "DenDF"],
                  metab_anova[term_name, "F value"],
                  metab_anova[term_name, "Pr(>F)"]))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# COEFFICIENTS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
metab_coefs <- broom.mixed::tidy(metab_model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(effect == "fixed")

message("\n  Fixed effects:")
for (i in 1:nrow(metab_coefs)) {
  message(sprintf("    %s: beta = %.4f (95%% CI: %.4f - %.4f), p = %.4f",
                  metab_coefs$term[i],
                  metab_coefs$estimate[i],
                  metab_coefs$conf.low[i],
                  metab_coefs$conf.high[i],
                  metab_coefs$p.value[i]))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# EXPORTS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# ANOVA table
metab_anova_export <- as.data.frame(metab_anova) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term")
metab_anova_export$model_used <- model_used
metab_anova_export$n_patients <- n_patients_metab
metab_anova_export$n_obs <- n_obs_metab
metab_anova_export$singular <- metab_singular

write.csv(metab_anova_export,
          file.path(clinical_output_dir, "secondary_metabolicrisk_type3_anova.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Coefficients
metab_coefs_export <- metab_coefs
metab_coefs_export$model_used <- model_used
metab_coefs_export$n_patients <- n_patients_metab

write.csv(metab_coefs_export,
          file.path(clinical_output_dir, "secondary_metabolicrisk_coefficients.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

message("\n  Exports:")
message("    secondary_metabolicrisk_type3_anova.csv")
message("    secondary_metabolicrisk_coefficients.csv")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# INLINE SUMMARY
# ------------------------------------------------------------
metab_score_row <- metab_anova_export %>% filter(term == "metabolic_risk_score")
if (nrow(metab_score_row) > 0) {
  message(sprintf("\n  RESULT: metabolic_risk_score F = %.2f, p = %.4f (%s)",
                  metab_score_row$`F value`,
                  metab_score_row$`Pr(>F)`,
                  ifelse(metab_score_row$`Pr(>F)` < 0.05, "significant", "not significant")))
}

safe_print(metab_anova_export %>% dplyr::select(term, `F value`, `Pr(>F)`, n_patients, model_used))

message("\n========================================")
message("SECONDARY: Metabolic Risk Score COMPLETE")
message("========================================")
```
