## EXPLORATORY: Delta(V1-A) Praediktor-Analyse (akute inflammatorische Response)

**Fragestellung:** Welche wenigen, vorher festgelegten Baseline-Parameter erklaeren die akute Inflammationszunahme (Delta V1-A) ueber baseline score-Adjustierung hinaus?

**Design:**
- Outcome: delta_V1_A = score(V1) - score(A)
- A-priori Praediktoren (genau 3): age, gfr_cont, metabolic_risk_score
- Pro Praediktor getrenntes OLS mit score_A als Kovariable (Regression-to-mean-Kontrolle)
- MCP: BH-FDR ueber 3 Tests

```{r}
#| label: step10-exploratory-delta-predictors
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# ============================================================
# EXPLORATORY: Delta(V1-A) Predictor Analysis
# ============================================================
# Outcome: delta_V1_A = score(V1) - score(A)
# Predictors (a-priori, exactly 3): age, gfr_cont, metabolic_risk_score
# Model: delta_V1_A ~ predictor_z + score_A (OLS, per predictor)
# MCP: BH-FDR over 3 tests
# ============================================================

message("\n========================================")
message("EXPLORATORY: Delta(V1-A) Predictor Analysis")
message("========================================\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PREREQUISITE CHECKS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("sample_meta_clinical")) {
  stop("FEHLER: sample_meta_clinical nicht gefunden.")
}

delta_required <- c("pid", "timepoint", "clinical_inflammation_score", "age", "metabolic_risk_score")
delta_missing <- setdiff(delta_required, names(sample_meta_clinical))
if (length(delta_missing) > 0) {
  stop("FEHLER: Fehlende Spalten: ", paste(delta_missing, collapse = ", "))
}

# gfr_cont must exist (not derived automatically)
if (!"gfr_cont" %in% names(sample_meta_clinical)) {
  stop("FEHLER: gfr_cont nicht in sample_meta_clinical gefunden. ",
       "Bitte Schritt 2 Variable Engineering ausfuehren (gfr_cont = pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd).")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# CONSTRUCT PATIENT-LEVEL WIDE TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------
delta_wide <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("A", "V1")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(clinical_inflammation_score)) %>%
  dplyr::select(pid, timepoint, clinical_inflammation_score,
                age, gfr_cont, metabolic_risk_score) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(pid, age, gfr_cont, metabolic_risk_score),
    names_from = timepoint,
    values_from = clinical_inflammation_score,
    names_prefix = "score_"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(score_A), !is.na(score_V1)) %>%
  mutate(delta_V1_A = score_V1 - score_A)

n_delta_patients <- nrow(delta_wide)
message(sprintf("  Patients with A + V1: n = %d", n_delta_patients))

if (n_delta_patients < 30) {
  message("  WARNING: Low power (n < 30) — interpret effect sizes, not p-values")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# FIT MODELS (one per a-priori predictor)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
predictors <- c("age", "gfr_cont", "metabolic_risk_score")
delta_results <- list()

for (pred in predictors) {

  pred_data <- delta_wide %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[pred]]))
  n_pred <- nrow(pred_data)

  if (n_pred < 10) {
    message(sprintf("  SKIPPED %s: n = %d (< 10)", pred, n_pred))
    next
  }

  # Standardize predictor
  pred_data[[paste0(pred, "_z")]] <- as.numeric(scale(pred_data[[pred]]))

  # OLS: delta_V1_A ~ predictor_z + score_A
  formula_str <- paste0("delta_V1_A ~ ", pred, "_z + score_A")
  fit <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = pred_data)

  # Extract predictor coefficient
  coef_tbl <- tryCatch({
    tidy_fit <- broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE)
    tidy_fit %>% filter(term == paste0(pred, "_z"))
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(coef_tbl) || nrow(coef_tbl) == 0) {
    message(sprintf("  FAILED to extract coefficient for %s", pred))
    next
  }

  # Model diagnostics
  r_sq <- summary(fit)$r.squared
  sigma <- summary(fit)$sigma

  # Robust SE (HC3)
  robust_se <- NA_real_
  robust_ci_low <- NA_real_
  robust_ci_high <- NA_real_
  tryCatch({
    if (requireNamespace("sandwich", quietly = TRUE) &&
        requireNamespace("lmtest", quietly = TRUE)) {
      robust_test <- lmtest::coeftest(fit, vcov = sandwich::vcovHC(fit, type = "HC3"))
      pred_z_name <- paste0(pred, "_z")
      robust_se <- robust_test[pred_z_name, "Std. Error"]
      robust_ci_low <- coef_tbl$estimate - 1.96 * robust_se
      robust_ci_high <- coef_tbl$estimate + 1.96 * robust_se
    }
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  delta_results[[pred]] <- data.frame(
    predictor = pred,
    beta = coef_tbl$estimate,
    se = coef_tbl$std.error,
    conf.low = coef_tbl$conf.low,
    conf.high = coef_tbl$conf.high,
    p_value = coef_tbl$p.value,
    robust_se = robust_se,
    robust_ci_low = robust_ci_low,
    robust_ci_high = robust_ci_high,
    n_patients = n_pred,
    r_squared = r_sq,
    sigma = sigma,
    note = "adjusted for score_A; predictor standardized (z)",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  message(sprintf("  %s: beta = %.4f (95%% CI: %.4f - %.4f), p = %.4f, n = %d",
                  pred, coef_tbl$estimate, coef_tbl$conf.low, coef_tbl$conf.high,
                  coef_tbl$p.value, n_pred))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# COMBINE AND APPLY BH-FDR
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if (length(delta_results) > 0) {

  delta_models_df <- bind_rows(delta_results)
  delta_models_df$p_adj <- p.adjust(delta_models_df$p_value, method = "BH")

  message("\n  BH-adjusted p-values:")
  for (i in 1:nrow(delta_models_df)) {
    message(sprintf("    %s: p = %.4f, p_adj = %.4f %s",
                    delta_models_df$predictor[i],
                    delta_models_df$p_value[i],
                    delta_models_df$p_adj[i],
                    ifelse(delta_models_df$p_adj[i] < 0.05, "*", "ns")))
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # EXPORT
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  write.csv(delta_models_df,
            file.path(clinical_output_dir, "deltaV1A_predictor_models.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)

  message("\n  Export: deltaV1A_predictor_models.csv")

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # INLINE SUMMARY TABLE
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  message("\n--- Delta(V1-A) Predictor Results ---")
  safe_print(delta_models_df %>%
    dplyr::select(predictor, beta, conf.low, conf.high, p_value, p_adj, n_patients))

} else {
  message("  WARNING: No predictor models fitted successfully")
}

message("\n========================================")
message("EXPLORATORY: Delta(V1-A) Predictors COMPLETE")
message("========================================")
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
```

# SCHRITT 11: Transkriptom-weite klinische Integration

**Ziel:** Systematische Prüfung, ob klinische Baseline-Variablen mit dem **gesamten Transkriptom** assoziieren — nicht nur mit dem a-priori definierten Inflammation-Composite-Score (Schritt 9/10).

**Motivation:**
Die bisherigen Analysen (Schritte 9–10) testen Klinik → GSVA-Composite (3 Pathways) und waren überwiegend nicht signifikant. Hier wird der Suchraum unbiased geöffnet:

- **11a:** Alle 50 Hallmark-Pathways × klinische Variablen (GSVA breit)
- **11b:** PCA-Achsen × klinische Variablen (unbiased, keine Pathway-Vorselektion)

**Methodische Basis:**
- Hänzelmann et al. 2013 (GSVA): Sample-level Pathway-Scores
- Ritchie et al. 2015 (limma): Empirische Bayes-Moderation
- Kontrolle: BH-FDR innerhalb jeder klinischen Variable über Pathways/PCs

## 11.0 Voraussetzungen: Daten laden

```{r}
#| label: step11-prereq-load
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("========================================")
message("SCHRITT 11: Transkriptom-weite Integration")
message("========================================\n")

# ============================================================
# Voraussetzungen: sample_meta_clinical + GSVA + VST laden
# ============================================================

# --- sample_meta_clinical (aus Step 3/6, oder Cache) ---
if (!exists("sample_meta_clinical")) {
  smc_path <- file.path(clinical_cache_dir, "sample_meta_clinical.rds")
  if (file.exists(smc_path)) {
    sample_meta_clinical <- readRDS(smc_path)
    message("✓ sample_meta_clinical aus Cache geladen: ", nrow(sample_meta_clinical), " Samples")
  } else {
    stop("❌ sample_meta_clinical nicht gefunden. Bitte Schritte 1–6 ausführen.")
  }
}

# --- Volle GSVA-Hallmark-Matrix (50 Pathways × Samples) ---
gsva_hallmark_full_path <- "../../../res/cache/gsva_hallmark_scores.rds"
if (!file.exists(gsva_hallmark_full_path)) {
  stop("❌ GSVA-Hallmark-Cache nicht gefunden: ", gsva_hallmark_full_path,
       "\n   Bitte DEanalysis.qmd (Chunk gsva-hallmark) ausführen.")
}
gsva_hallmark_full <- readRDS(gsva_hallmark_full_path)
message("✓ GSVA-Hallmark-Matrix geladen: ", nrow(gsva_hallmark_full), " Pathways × ",
        ncol(gsva_hallmark_full), " Samples")

# --- VST-Matrix (für PCA) ---
# Zwei mögliche Cache-Dateien (mit/ohne Hash-Suffix)
vst_candidates <- c(
  "../../../res/cache/vst_blind_TRUE.rds",
  list.files("../../../res/cache", pattern = "^vst_blind_TRUE.*\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
)
vst_candidates <- unique(vst_candidates[file.exists(vst_candidates)])

if (length(vst_candidates) == 0) {
  message("⚠️ VST-Cache nicht gefunden — PCA-Analyse (11b) wird übersprungen")
  vst_available <- FALSE
} else {
  # Lade die neueste Datei (falls mehrere Versionen existieren)
  vst_obj <- readRDS(vst_candidates[length(vst_candidates)])

  # Extrahiere Matrix (SummarizedExperiment oder direkt Matrix)
  if (inherits(vst_obj, "SummarizedExperiment") || inherits(vst_obj, "DESeqTransform")) {
    vst_mat <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(vst_obj)
  } else if (is.matrix(vst_obj)) {
    vst_mat <- vst_obj
  } else {
    stop("❌ Unerwartetes Format des VST-Cache: ", class(vst_obj))
  }

  message("✓ VST-Matrix geladen: ", nrow(vst_mat), " Gene × ", ncol(vst_mat), " Samples")
  vst_available <- TRUE
}

# --- Klinische Variablen für systematisches Screening definieren ---
# Nur Variablen mit ausreichender Varianz/Fallzahl
clinical_screen_vars <- list(
  continuous = c("pr_errechnete_gfr_mdrd", "pr_echo_ef_percent", "euroscore_ii_percent", "age", "bmi"),
  binary     = c("diabetes", "gfr_impaired", "valve_type_grouped", "sex")
)

# Prüfe Verfügbarkeit in sample_meta_clinical
avail_cont <- intersect(clinical_screen_vars$continuous, names(sample_meta_clinical))
avail_bin  <- intersect(clinical_screen_vars$binary, names(sample_meta_clinical))

message(sprintf("\nKlinische Screening-Variablen: %d kontinuierlich, %d binär",
                length(avail_cont), length(avail_bin)))
message("  Kontinuierlich: ", paste(avail_cont, collapse = ", "))
message("  Binär: ", paste(avail_bin, collapse = ", "))

message("\n✓ Voraussetzungen für Schritt 11 erfüllt")
```

## 11a: Breites GSVA-Hallmark-Screening (50 Pathways × Klinik)

**Fragestellung:** Welche der 50 MSigDB-Hallmark-Pathways assoziieren mit klinischen Baseline-Variablen — jenseits der a-priori definierten Inflammation-Signatur?

**Design:**
- Pro Pathway × klinische Variable: LMM mit `gsva_score ~ timepoint + clinical_var + (1|pid)`
- Multiple Testing: BH-FDR pro klinische Variable über 50 Pathways
- Visualisierung: Heatmap (signierte -log10 p-Werte)

```{r}
#| label: step11a-gsva-broad-clinical
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("========================================")
message("11a: Breites GSVA-Hallmark-Screening")
message("========================================\n")

# ============================================================
# Datenaufbereitung: GSVA-Matrix in Long-Format
# ============================================================

# Transponiere GSVA-Matrix: Samples × Pathways
gsva_long <- gsva_hallmark_full %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("pathway") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -pathway,
    names_to = "sample_id",
    values_to = "gsva_score"
  )

# Merge mit klinischen Daten
gsva_long <- gsva_long %>%
  inner_join(
    sample_meta_clinical %>%
      dplyr::select(sample_id, pid, timepoint, age, sex,
                    any_of(c(avail_cont, avail_bin))),
    by = "sample_id"
  )

# Timepoint als Faktor sicherstellen
gsva_long$timepoint <- factor(gsva_long$timepoint, levels = c("A", "V1", "V2"))

n_pathways <- n_distinct(gsva_long$pathway)
n_samples  <- n_distinct(gsva_long$sample_id)
n_patients <- n_distinct(gsva_long$pid)

message(sprintf("Daten: %d Pathways × %d Samples (%d Patienten)", n_pathways, n_samples, n_patients))
message(sprintf("Beobachtungen: %d (long format)", nrow(gsva_long)))

# ============================================================
# Systematisches Screening: LMM pro Pathway × Klinik-Variable
# ============================================================

# Sammle alle Ergebnisse
gsva_broad_results <- list()

# --- Kontinuierliche Variablen ---
for (cvar in avail_cont) {

  message(sprintf("\n--- Klinische Variable: %s (kontinuierlich) ---", cvar))

  # z-Standardisierung innerhalb der Analyse (Vergleichbarkeit der Effektgrößen)
  gsva_long[[paste0(cvar, "_z")]] <- as.numeric(scale(gsva_long[[cvar]]))

  # Filtere NAs für diese Variable
  gsva_sub <- gsva_long %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[paste0(cvar, "_z")]]))

  if (n_distinct(gsva_sub$pid) < 20) {
    message(sprintf("  ⚠️ SKIPPED: n = %d Patienten (< 20)", n_distinct(gsva_sub$pid)))
    next
  }

  cvar_z <- paste0(cvar, "_z")
  n_ok <- 0
  n_fail <- 0
  pw_results <- list()

  for (pw in unique(gsva_sub$pathway)) {

    pw_data <- gsva_sub %>% filter(pathway == pw)

    # LMM: gsva_score ~ timepoint + clinical_var_z + (1|pid)
    fit <- tryCatch({
      lmerTest::lmer(
        as.formula(paste0("gsva_score ~ timepoint + ", cvar_z, " + (1|pid)")),
        data = pw_data,
        REML = TRUE,
        control = lme4::lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE)
      )
    }, error = function(e) NULL, warning = function(w) {
      suppressWarnings(
        lmerTest::lmer(
          as.formula(paste0("gsva_score ~ timepoint + ", cvar_z, " + (1|pid)")),
          data = pw_data,
          REML = TRUE,
          control = lme4::lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE)
        )
      )
    })

    if (is.null(fit)) { n_fail <- n_fail + 1; next }

    # Extrahiere Koeffizienten der klinischen Variable
    coef_tbl <- tryCatch(
      broom.mixed::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
        filter(effect == "fixed", term == cvar_z),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(coef_tbl) || nrow(coef_tbl) == 0) { n_fail <- n_fail + 1; next }

    pw_results[[pw]] <- coef_tbl %>%
      mutate(pathway = pw, clinical_var = cvar, var_type = "continuous",
             n_obs = nrow(pw_data), n_patients = n_distinct(pw_data$pid))

    n_ok <- n_ok + 1
  }

  if (length(pw_results) > 0) {
    pw_df <- bind_rows(pw_results)
    pw_df$p_adj <- p.adjust(pw_df$p.value, method = "BH")
    gsva_broad_results[[cvar]] <- pw_df
    n_sig <- sum(pw_df$p_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
    message(sprintf("  ✓ %d/%d Pathways konvergiert, %d Modelle fehlgeschlagen",
                    n_ok, n_ok + n_fail, n_fail))
    message(sprintf("  → %d Pathways FDR < 0.05", n_sig))
  }
}

# --- Binäre Variablen ---
for (bvar in avail_bin) {

  message(sprintf("\n--- Klinische Variable: %s (binär) ---", bvar))

  gsva_sub <- gsva_long %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[bvar]]))

  # Gruppengröße prüfen
  group_n <- gsva_sub %>%
    distinct(pid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::count(.data[[bvar]])

  if (any(group_n$n < clinical_params$min_n_per_group)) {
    message(sprintf("  ⚠️ SKIPPED: Mindestens eine Gruppe n < %d",
                    clinical_params$min_n_per_group))
    message("    ", paste(capture.output(print(as.data.frame(group_n))), collapse = "\n    "))
    next
  }

  # Sicherstellen: Faktor
  gsva_sub[[bvar]] <- factor(gsva_sub[[bvar]])

  n_ok <- 0
  n_fail <- 0
  pw_results <- list()

  for (pw in unique(gsva_sub$pathway)) {

    pw_data <- gsva_sub %>% filter(pathway == pw)

    fit <- tryCatch({
      lmerTest::lmer(
        as.formula(paste0("gsva_score ~ timepoint + ", bvar, " + (1|pid)")),
        data = pw_data,
        REML = TRUE,
        control = lme4::lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE)
      )
    }, error = function(e) NULL, warning = function(w) {
      suppressWarnings(
        lmerTest::lmer(
          as.formula(paste0("gsva_score ~ timepoint + ", bvar, " + (1|pid)")),
          data = pw_data,
          REML = TRUE,
          control = lme4::lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE)
        )
      )
    })

    if (is.null(fit)) { n_fail <- n_fail + 1; next }

    coef_tbl <- tryCatch(
      broom.mixed::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
        filter(effect == "fixed", !term %in% c("(Intercept)", "timepointV1", "timepointV2")),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(coef_tbl) || nrow(coef_tbl) == 0) { n_fail <- n_fail + 1; next }

    pw_results[[pw]] <- coef_tbl %>%
      mutate(pathway = pw, clinical_var = bvar, var_type = "binary",
             n_obs = nrow(pw_data), n_patients = n_distinct(pw_data$pid))

    n_ok <- n_ok + 1
  }

  if (length(pw_results) > 0) {
    pw_df <- bind_rows(pw_results)
    pw_df$p_adj <- p.adjust(pw_df$p.value, method = "BH")
    gsva_broad_results[[bvar]] <- pw_df
    n_sig <- sum(pw_df$p_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
    message(sprintf("  ✓ %d/%d Pathways konvergiert, %d Modelle fehlgeschlagen",
                    n_ok, n_ok + n_fail, n_fail))
    message(sprintf("  → %d Pathways FDR < 0.05", n_sig))
  }
}

# ============================================================
# Ergebnistabelle zusammenführen und exportieren
# ============================================================

if (length(gsva_broad_results) > 0) {

  gsva_broad_all <- bind_rows(gsva_broad_results)

  # Kürze Pathway-Namen für Lesbarkeit
  gsva_broad_all <- gsva_broad_all %>%
    mutate(pathway_short = gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", pathway))

  # Export
  write.csv(
    gsva_broad_all,
    file.path(clinical_output_dir, "step11a_gsva_broad_clinical_association.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  message(sprintf("\n✓ Gespeichert: step11a_gsva_broad_clinical_association.csv (%d Zeilen)", nrow(gsva_broad_all)))

  # ============================================================
  # Zusammenfassungstabelle: Signifikante Assoziationen
  # ============================================================

  gsva_sig_summary <- gsva_broad_all %>%
    filter(p_adj < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(p_adj) %>%
    dplyr::select(clinical_var, pathway_short, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, p_adj, n_patients)

  if (nrow(gsva_sig_summary) > 0) {
    message(sprintf("\n--- %d signifikante Assoziationen (FDR < 0.05) ---", nrow(gsva_sig_summary)))
    safe_print(head(gsva_sig_summary, 20))
  } else {
    message("\n--- Keine signifikanten Assoziationen (FDR < 0.05) ---")
    message("Hinweis: Auch bei n = 46 können moderate Effekte unter der FDR-Schwelle bleiben.")
    message("Nominell signifikante Ergebnisse (p < 0.05, ohne FDR):")
    gsva_nom_summary <- gsva_broad_all %>%
      filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
      arrange(p.value) %>%
      dplyr::select(clinical_var, pathway_short, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, p_adj, n_patients)
    safe_print(head(gsva_nom_summary, 15))
  }

  # ============================================================
  # Heatmap: Pathways × Klinik (signierte -log10 p)
  # ============================================================

  # Aufbereitung: Pivot zu Matrix (Pathways × Variablen)
  heatmap_data <- gsva_broad_all %>%
    mutate(
      signed_logp = -log10(pmax(p.value, 1e-10)) * sign(estimate)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway_short, clinical_var, signed_logp) %>%
    # Bei binären Variablen: nur erste Stufe (nicht-Referenz)
    distinct(pathway_short, clinical_var, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = clinical_var,
      values_from = signed_logp,
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("pathway_short")

  if (ncol(heatmap_data) >= 2 && nrow(heatmap_data) >= 5) {

    # FDR-Markierung: Sternchen-Matrix
    fdr_matrix <- gsva_broad_all %>%
      mutate(fdr_star = case_when(
        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE          ~ ""
      )) %>%
      distinct(pathway_short, clinical_var, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::select(pathway_short, clinical_var, fdr_star) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = clinical_var,
        values_from = fdr_star,
        values_fill = ""
      ) %>%
      tibble::column_to_rownames("pathway_short")

    # Ordne gleich wie Heatmap
    fdr_matrix <- fdr_matrix[rownames(heatmap_data), colnames(heatmap_data), drop = FALSE]

    # Farbpalette: blau (negativ) → weiß → rot (positiv)
    heatmap_breaks <- seq(-4, 4, length.out = 101)
    heatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "#F7F7F7", "#B2182B"))(100)

    # Begrenze Werte auf [-4, 4] (Skalierung)
    heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(heatmap_data)
    heatmap_mat[heatmap_mat > 4]  <- 4
    heatmap_mat[heatmap_mat < -4] <- -4

    heatmap_file <- file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "step11a_gsva_broad_clinical_heatmap.png")

    png(heatmap_file, width = 10, height = 14, units = "in", res = 150)
    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      heatmap_mat,
      display_numbers = as.matrix(fdr_matrix),
      fontsize_number = 8,
      color = heatmap_colors,
      breaks = heatmap_breaks,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      border_color = "grey90",
      fontsize_row = 7,
      fontsize_col = 9,
      main = "GSVA Hallmark × Klinische Variablen\n(signiertes -log10 p, * FDR < 0.05)",
      angle_col = 45
    )
    dev.off()
    message("✓ Heatmap gespeichert: ", basename(heatmap_file))

  } else {
    message("⚠️ Heatmap übersprungen: zu wenige Variablen/Pathways für sinnvolle Darstellung")
  }

  # ============================================================
  # Sensitivity: Top-5 Pathways pro Variable als Spaghetti-Plot
  # ============================================================

  gsva_top5 <- gsva_broad_all %>%
    group_by(clinical_var) %>%
    arrange(p.value) %>%
    slice_head(n = 5) %>%
    ungroup()

  if (nrow(gsva_top5) > 0) {
    write.csv(
      gsva_top5 %>%
        dplyr::select(clinical_var, pathway_short, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, p_adj),
      file.path(clinical_output_dir, "step11a_gsva_broad_top5_per_variable.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    message("✓ Top-5 Pathways pro Variable gespeichert: step11a_gsva_broad_top5_per_variable.csv")
  }

} else {
  message("⚠️ Keine GSVA-Screening-Ergebnisse generiert")
}

message("\n✓ 11a: GSVA-Hallmark-Screening abgeschlossen")
```

### 11a-Sensitivity: Global BH-FDR over all Step 11a Tests

**Fragestellung:** Welche Step-11a Treffer bleiben unter globaler FDR-Kontrolle (alle ~400 Tests) bestehen?

**Reviewer-Kontext:** Macht die Hypothesefamilie transparent; verhindert den Eindruck, dass ein einzelner Treffer aus 400 Tests als "Discovery" verkauft wird. Globales BH als konservative Obergrenze.

```{r}
#| label: step11a-sensitivity-global-fdr
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# ============================================================
# SENSITIVITY: Global BH-FDR for Step 11a
# ============================================================
# Adds p_adj_global (BH over ALL Step-11a tests) to existing results
# Does NOT modify the original step11a_gsva_broad_clinical_association.csv
# ============================================================

message("\n========================================")
message("SENSITIVITY: Step 11a Global BH-FDR")
message("========================================\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD existing Step 11a results
# ------------------------------------------------------------
step11a_path <- file.path(clinical_output_dir, "step11a_gsva_broad_clinical_association.csv")

if (!file.exists(step11a_path)) {
  stop("FEHLER: step11a_gsva_broad_clinical_association.csv nicht gefunden unter: ", step11a_path,
       "\n  Bitte Step 11a zuerst ausfuehren.")
}

step11a_orig <- read.csv(step11a_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Validate required columns
required_11a_cols <- c("p.value", "p_adj", "clinical_var", "pathway")
missing_11a <- setdiff(required_11a_cols, names(step11a_orig))
if (length(missing_11a) > 0) {
  stop("FEHLER: Fehlende Spalten in step11a CSV: ", paste(missing_11a, collapse = ", "))
}

n_tests_total <- sum(!is.na(step11a_orig$p.value))
message(sprintf("  Loaded Step 11a results: %d rows, %d with valid p-values", nrow(step11a_orig), n_tests_total))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# COMPUTE global BH-FDR
# ------------------------------------------------------------
step11a_global <- step11a_orig
step11a_global$p_adj_global <- NA_real_
valid_p_idx <- !is.na(step11a_global$p.value)
step11a_global$p_adj_global[valid_p_idx] <- p.adjust(step11a_global$p.value[valid_p_idx], method = "BH")

# Verify row count unchanged
stopifnot(nrow(step11a_global) == nrow(step11a_orig))
message(sprintf("  Row count preserved: %d (original) == %d (with global FDR)", nrow(step11a_orig), nrow(step11a_global)))

# Count hits
n_sig_pervar <- sum(step11a_global$p_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
n_sig_global <- sum(step11a_global$p_adj_global < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

message(sprintf("  Hits per-variable BH (p_adj < 0.05):  %d", n_sig_pervar))
message(sprintf("  Hits global BH (p_adj_global < 0.05): %d", n_sig_global))

# Sanity check: PEROXISOME × sex
perox_sex <- step11a_global %>%
  filter(grepl("PEROXISOME", pathway, ignore.case = TRUE),
         clinical_var == "sex")

if (nrow(perox_sex) > 0) {
  message(sprintf("  Sanity: sex x PEROXISOME: p_adj = %.4f, p_adj_global = %.4f",
                  perox_sex$p_adj[1], perox_sex$p_adj_global[1]))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# TOP HIT (global)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
top_hit_global <- step11a_global %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_adj_global)) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_global) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SUMMARY TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------
summary_11a_global <- data.frame(
  metric = c("n_tests_total", "n_sig_pervar_BH", "n_sig_global_BH",
             "top_hit_clinical_var", "top_hit_pathway",
             "top_hit_estimate", "top_hit_p_value",
             "top_hit_p_adj_pervar", "top_hit_p_adj_global"),
  value = c(
    as.character(n_tests_total),
    as.character(n_sig_pervar),
    as.character(n_sig_global),
    if (nrow(top_hit_global) > 0) top_hit_global$clinical_var else NA,
    if (nrow(top_hit_global) > 0) top_hit_global$pathway else NA,
    if (nrow(top_hit_global) > 0) as.character(round(top_hit_global$estimate, 4)) else NA,
    if (nrow(top_hit_global) > 0) as.character(signif(top_hit_global$p.value, 4)) else NA,
    if (nrow(top_hit_global) > 0) as.character(signif(top_hit_global$p_adj, 4)) else NA,
    if (nrow(top_hit_global) > 0) as.character(signif(top_hit_global$p_adj_global, 4)) else NA
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# EXPORTS (new files only)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
write.csv(step11a_global,
          file.path(clinical_output_dir, "step11a_gsva_broad_clinical_association_with_globalFDR.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(summary_11a_global,
          file.path(clinical_output_dir, "step11a_globalFDR_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

message("\n  Exports:")
message("    step11a_gsva_broad_clinical_association_with_globalFDR.csv")
message("    step11a_globalFDR_summary.csv")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# INLINE REPORT
# ------------------------------------------------------------
message(sprintf("\n--- Global FDR Sensitivity ---"))
message(sprintf("Unter globalem BH (alle %d Tests): %d Treffer (FDR < 0.05).", n_tests_total, n_sig_global))
if (n_sig_global == 0) {
  message("Kein einzelner Test ueberlebt die globale FDR-Korrektur.")
  message(sprintf("Per-variable BH liefert %d Treffer — diese sind als screening-interne Priorisierung zu werten, nicht als Discovery-Claim.", n_sig_pervar))
}

safe_print(summary_11a_global)

message("\n========================================")
message("SENSITIVITY: Step 11a Global FDR COMPLETE")
message("========================================")
```

## 11b: PCA × Klinische Variablen

**Fragestellung:** Welche Hauptkomponenten der Gesamtexpression assoziieren mit klinischen Baseline-Variablen?

**Design:**
- PCA auf VST-Matrix (blind, alle Timepoints)
- Longitudinal: `PC_k ~ timepoint + clinical_var + (1|pid)` pro PC × Variable
- Baseline-Querschnitt (nur Zeitpunkt A): `PC_k ~ clinical_var + age + sex`
- Multiple Testing: BH-FDR über 10 PCs × m Variablen, getrennt nach Modelltyp
- Interpretation: Top-Loadings der assoziierten PCs (biologische Achsen)

```{r}
#| label: step11b-pca-clinical
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("========================================")
message("11b: PCA × Klinische Variablen")
message("========================================\n")

if (!vst_available) {
  message("⚠️ VST-Matrix nicht verfügbar — Analyse übersprungen")
  message("   Bitte DEanalysis.qmd (VST-Chunk) ausführen und erneut rendern")
} else {

  # ============================================================
  # PCA berechnen
  # ============================================================

  # PCA auf transponierter VST-Matrix (Samples in Zeilen)
  pca_result <- prcomp(t(vst_mat), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

  # Varianzanteile
  pca_var_pct <- round(100 * (pca_result$sdev^2 / sum(pca_result$sdev^2)), 2)
  n_pcs <- min(10, ncol(pca_result$x))  # Maximal 10 PCs

  message(sprintf("PCA: %d Samples, %d Gene", ncol(vst_mat), nrow(vst_mat)))
  message(sprintf("Top %d PCs erklären %.1f%% der Gesamtvarianz",
                  n_pcs, sum(pca_var_pct[1:n_pcs])))
  for (i in 1:min(5, n_pcs)) {
    message(sprintf("  PC%d: %.1f%%", i, pca_var_pct[i]))
  }

  # PC-Scores als Dataframe
  pc_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x[, 1:n_pcs])
  pc_scores$sample_id <- rownames(pc_scores)

  # Merge mit klinischen Daten
  pc_clinical <- pc_scores %>%
    inner_join(
      sample_meta_clinical %>%
        dplyr::select(sample_id, pid, timepoint, age, sex,
                      any_of(c(avail_cont, avail_bin))),
      by = "sample_id"
    )

  pc_clinical$timepoint <- factor(pc_clinical$timepoint, levels = c("A", "V1", "V2"))

  message(sprintf("Nach Merge: %d Samples mit klinischen Daten", nrow(pc_clinical)))

  # ============================================================
  # A) Longitudinale Assoziation: PC ~ timepoint + Klinik + (1|pid)
  # ============================================================

  message("\n--- A) Longitudinale Modelle ---")

  pca_long_results <- list()

  all_vars <- c(avail_cont, avail_bin)

  for (cvar in all_vars) {

    # Bestimme Variablentyp
    is_cont <- cvar %in% avail_cont

    # z-Standardisierung für kontinuierliche Variablen
    if (is_cont) {
      pc_clinical[[paste0(cvar, "_z")]] <- as.numeric(scale(pc_clinical[[cvar]]))
      model_var <- paste0(cvar, "_z")
    } else {
      pc_clinical[[cvar]] <- factor(pc_clinical[[cvar]])
      model_var <- cvar
    }

    pc_sub <- pc_clinical %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[cvar]]))

    # Stichproben-Check
    if (n_distinct(pc_sub$pid) < 20) next

    for (pc_idx in 1:n_pcs) {
      pc_name <- paste0("PC", pc_idx)

      fit <- tryCatch({
        lmerTest::lmer(
          as.formula(paste0(pc_name, " ~ timepoint + ", model_var, " + (1|pid)")),
          data = pc_sub,
          REML = TRUE,
          control = lme4::lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE)
        )
      }, error = function(e) NULL)

      if (is.null(fit)) next

      # Koeffizient der klinischen Variable extrahieren
      coef_tbl <- tryCatch(
        broom.mixed::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
          filter(effect == "fixed",
                 !term %in% c("(Intercept)", "timepointV1", "timepointV2")),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      if (is.null(coef_tbl) || nrow(coef_tbl) == 0) next

      pca_long_results[[paste0(cvar, "_", pc_name)]] <- coef_tbl %>%
        mutate(pc = pc_name, pc_var_pct = pca_var_pct[pc_idx],
               clinical_var = cvar, var_type = ifelse(is_cont, "continuous", "binary"),
               model_type = "longitudinal",
               n_obs = nrow(pc_sub), n_patients = n_distinct(pc_sub$pid))
    }
  }

  if (length(pca_long_results) > 0) {
    pca_long_df <- bind_rows(pca_long_results)
    pca_long_df$p_adj <- p.adjust(pca_long_df$p.value, method = "BH")

    n_sig_long <- sum(pca_long_df$p_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
    message(sprintf("  %d Tests durchgeführt, %d FDR < 0.05", nrow(pca_long_df), n_sig_long))
  } else {
    pca_long_df <- tibble()
    message("  Keine longitudinalen Ergebnisse")
  }

  # ============================================================
  # B) Baseline-Querschnitt (nur Zeitpunkt A): PC ~ Klinik + age + sex
  # ============================================================

  message("\n--- B) Baseline-Querschnitt (Zeitpunkt A) ---")

  pc_baseline <- pc_clinical %>%
    filter(timepoint == "A")

  message(sprintf("Baseline-Samples: n = %d", nrow(pc_baseline)))

  pca_baseline_results <- list()

  for (cvar in all_vars) {

    is_cont <- cvar %in% avail_cont

    # Confounders: age + sex (aber nicht, wenn cvar selbst age oder sex ist)
    confounders <- c()
    if (cvar != "age" && "age" %in% names(pc_baseline)) confounders <- c(confounders, "age")
    if (cvar != "sex" && "sex" %in% names(pc_baseline)) confounders <- c(confounders, "sex")
    covariate_str <- if (length(confounders) > 0) paste0(" + ", paste(confounders, collapse = " + ")) else ""

    if (is_cont) {
      pc_baseline[[paste0(cvar, "_z")]] <- as.numeric(scale(pc_baseline[[cvar]]))
      model_var <- paste0(cvar, "_z")
    } else {
      pc_baseline[[cvar]] <- factor(pc_baseline[[cvar]])
      model_var <- cvar
    }

    pc_sub_bl <- pc_baseline %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[cvar]]))

    if (nrow(pc_sub_bl) < 20) next

    for (pc_idx in 1:n_pcs) {
      pc_name <- paste0("PC", pc_idx)

      fit_bl <- tryCatch({
        lm(as.formula(paste0(pc_name, " ~ ", model_var, covariate_str)),
           data = pc_sub_bl)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)

      if (is.null(fit_bl)) next

      coef_tbl_bl <- tryCatch(
        broom::tidy(fit_bl, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
          filter(!term %in% c("(Intercept)", "age", "sexmale", "sexfemale")),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      if (is.null(coef_tbl_bl) || nrow(coef_tbl_bl) == 0) next

      pca_baseline_results[[paste0(cvar, "_", pc_name)]] <- coef_tbl_bl %>%
        mutate(pc = pc_name, pc_var_pct = pca_var_pct[pc_idx],
               clinical_var = cvar, var_type = ifelse(is_cont, "continuous", "binary"),
               model_type = "baseline_A",
               n_obs = nrow(pc_sub_bl), n_patients = nrow(pc_sub_bl))
    }
  }

  if (length(pca_baseline_results) > 0) {
    pca_baseline_df <- bind_rows(pca_baseline_results)
    pca_baseline_df$p_adj <- p.adjust(pca_baseline_df$p.value, method = "BH")

    n_sig_bl <- sum(pca_baseline_df$p_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
    message(sprintf("  %d Tests durchgeführt, %d FDR < 0.05", nrow(pca_baseline_df), n_sig_bl))
  } else {
    pca_baseline_df <- tibble()
    message("  Keine Baseline-Ergebnisse")
  }

  # ============================================================
  # Ergebnisse zusammenführen und exportieren
  # ============================================================

  pca_all_results <- bind_rows(pca_long_df, pca_baseline_df)

  if (nrow(pca_all_results) > 0) {

    write.csv(
      pca_all_results,
      file.path(clinical_output_dir, "step11b_pca_clinical_association.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    message(sprintf("\n✓ Gespeichert: step11b_pca_clinical_association.csv (%d Zeilen)", nrow(pca_all_results)))

    # --- Zusammenfassung signifikanter Befunde ---
    pca_sig <- pca_all_results %>%
      filter(p_adj < 0.05) %>%
      arrange(p_adj) %>%
      dplyr::select(model_type, clinical_var, pc, pc_var_pct, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, p_adj)

    if (nrow(pca_sig) > 0) {
      message(sprintf("\n--- %d signifikante PC-Klinik-Assoziationen (FDR < 0.05) ---", nrow(pca_sig)))
      safe_print(pca_sig)
    } else {
      message("\n--- Keine signifikanten PC-Klinik-Assoziationen (FDR < 0.05) ---")
      message("Nominelle Befunde (p < 0.05):")
      pca_nom <- pca_all_results %>%
        filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
        arrange(p.value) %>%
        dplyr::select(model_type, clinical_var, pc, pc_var_pct, estimate, p.value, p_adj)
      safe_print(head(pca_nom, 15))
    }

    # ============================================================
    # Heatmap: PCs × Klinik (signierte -log10 p)
    # ============================================================

    # Nur longitudinale Ergebnisse für kompakte Darstellung
    if (nrow(pca_long_df) > 0) {

      pca_heatmap_data <- pca_long_df %>%
        mutate(signed_logp = -log10(pmax(p.value, 1e-10)) * sign(estimate)) %>%
        distinct(pc, clinical_var, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
        dplyr::select(pc, clinical_var, signed_logp) %>%
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = clinical_var, values_from = signed_logp, values_fill = 0) %>%
        tibble::column_to_rownames("pc")

      # FDR-Sternchen
      pca_fdr_matrix <- pca_long_df %>%
        mutate(fdr_star = case_when(
          p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
          p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
          p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE          ~ ""
        )) %>%
        distinct(pc, clinical_var, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
        dplyr::select(pc, clinical_var, fdr_star) %>%
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = clinical_var, values_from = fdr_star, values_fill = "") %>%
        tibble::column_to_rownames("pc")

      pca_fdr_matrix <- pca_fdr_matrix[rownames(pca_heatmap_data), colnames(pca_heatmap_data), drop = FALSE]

      pca_heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(pca_heatmap_data)
      pca_heatmap_mat[pca_heatmap_mat > 4]  <- 4
      pca_heatmap_mat[pca_heatmap_mat < -4] <- -4

      # Zeilen-Labels mit Varianzanteil
      pc_labels <- paste0(rownames(pca_heatmap_mat), " (", pca_var_pct[1:nrow(pca_heatmap_mat)], "%)")

      pca_heatmap_file <- file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "step11b_pca_clinical_heatmap.png")

      png(pca_heatmap_file, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 150)
      pheatmap::pheatmap(
        pca_heatmap_mat,
        display_numbers = as.matrix(pca_fdr_matrix),
        fontsize_number = 9,
        color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "#F7F7F7", "#B2182B"))(100),
        breaks = seq(-4, 4, length.out = 101),
        cluster_rows = FALSE,
        cluster_cols = FALSE,
        border_color = "grey90",
        fontsize_row = 9,
        fontsize_col = 9,
        labels_row = pc_labels,
        main = "PCA × Klinische Variablen (longitudinal)\n(signiertes -log10 p, * FDR < 0.05)"
      )
      dev.off()
      message("✓ PCA-Heatmap gespeichert: ", basename(pca_heatmap_file))
    }

    # ============================================================
    # Top-Loadings der stärksten PCs: biologische Interpretation
    # ============================================================

    # Identifiziere PCs mit mindestens einem nominellen Signal
    pcs_with_signal <- pca_all_results %>%
      filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
      pull(pc) %>%
      unique()

    if (length(pcs_with_signal) > 0) {

      message(sprintf("\n--- Top-Loadings für %d PCs mit Signal ---", length(pcs_with_signal)))

      loadings_all <- list()

      for (pc_name in pcs_with_signal) {
        pc_idx <- as.integer(gsub("PC", "", pc_name))
        pc_loadings <- pca_result$rotation[, pc_idx]

        # Top 50 Gene (nach absolutem Loading)
        top_idx <- order(abs(pc_loadings), decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(50, length(pc_loadings))]

        loadings_all[[pc_name]] <- tibble(
          pc = pc_name,
          gene_id = names(pc_loadings[top_idx]),
          loading = pc_loadings[top_idx],
          abs_loading = abs(pc_loadings[top_idx]),
          direction = ifelse(pc_loadings[top_idx] > 0, "positive", "negative")
        )
      }

      loadings_df <- bind_rows(loadings_all)

      write.csv(
        loadings_df,
        file.path(clinical_output_dir, "step11b_pca_top_loadings.csv"),
        row.names = FALSE
      )
      message("✓ Top-Loadings gespeichert: step11b_pca_top_loadings.csv")

      # Kurzübersicht
      for (pc_name in pcs_with_signal) {
        top5 <- loadings_df %>%
          filter(pc == pc_name) %>%
          arrange(desc(abs_loading)) %>%
          head(5)
        message(sprintf("  %s Top-5: %s", pc_name, paste(top5$gene_id, collapse = ", ")))
      }

    } else {
      message("\nKeine PCs mit nominellem Signal (p < 0.05) — Loadings-Export übersprungen")
    }

  } else {
    message("\n⚠️ Keine PCA-Ergebnisse generiert")
  }

  message("\n✓ 11b: PCA-Klinik-Assoziation abgeschlossen")
}
```

## 11b2: Einzelgen-Assoziationen × Klinische Variablen (MVP-1)

**Strategie:** Teste hochvariable Gene (Top 5000 nach Varianz) gegen klinische Prädiktoren, um transkriptom-weite Assoziationen jenseits von Pathway-Aggregaten zu identifizieren.

**Methodik:**
- LMM pro Gen: `gene_expr ~ timepoint + clinical_var_z + (1|pid)`
- FDR-Korrektur innerhalb jeder klinischen Variable
- Fokus auf kontinuierliche Variablen (stärkere Power)

```{r}
#| label: step11b2-single-gene-clinical
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

if (exists("vst_mat") && exists("sample_meta_clinical")) {

  message("\n=== 11b2: Einzelgen × Klinische Variablen ===\n")

  # 1. Hochvariable Gene identifizieren (Top 5000)
  gene_vars <- apply(vst_mat, 1, stats::var, na.rm = TRUE)
  top_var_genes <- names(sort(gene_vars, decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(5000, length(gene_vars))])

  message(sprintf("Hochvariable Gene für Tests: %d (aus %d total)",
                  length(top_var_genes), nrow(vst_mat)))

  # 2. VST-Subset für hochvariable Gene
  vst_hvg <- vst_mat[top_var_genes, ]

  # 3. Definiere klinische Screening-Variablen (kontinuierlich bevorzugt)
  clinical_vars_continuous <- c("age", "bmi", "pr_errechnete_GFR_MDRD",
                                "Log_Euroscore_II", "pr_Echo_EF_percent")
  clinical_vars_binary <- c("male", "diabetes", "dyslipedemia", "hypertension",
                            "Atrial_Fibrillation_Flutter", "COPD", "pAVK")

  # Alle verfügbaren Variablen filtern (case-sensitive check)
  available_clinical <- intersect(
    c(clinical_vars_continuous, clinical_vars_binary),
    names(sample_meta_clinical)
  )

  # Falls keine direkten Matches: versuche case-insensitive
  if (length(available_clinical) < 3) {
    meta_names <- names(sample_meta_clinical)
    available_clinical <- c()
    for (clin_var_name in c(clinical_vars_continuous, clinical_vars_binary)) {
      match_idx <- which(tolower(meta_names) == tolower(clin_var_name))
      if (length(match_idx) > 0) {
        available_clinical <- c(available_clinical, meta_names[match_idx[1]])
      }
    }
    available_clinical <- unique(available_clinical)
  }

  message(sprintf("Klinische Variablen für Tests: %d", length(available_clinical)))
  message("  → ", paste(available_clinical, collapse = ", "))

  # 4. Prepare clinical data mit standardisierten kontinuierlichen Variablen
  # Identifiziere welche verfügbaren Variablen kontinuierlich sind
  available_continuous <- intersect(clinical_vars_continuous, available_clinical)

  clinical_screening_data <- sample_meta_clinical %>%
    dplyr::select(sample_id, pid, timepoint, all_of(available_clinical))

  # Standardisiere nur kontinuierliche Variablen
  if (length(available_continuous) > 0) {
    for (cont_var in available_continuous) {
      clinical_screening_data[[paste0(cont_var, "_z")]] <- as.numeric(scale(clinical_screening_data[[cont_var]]))
    }
  }

  # 5. Gene-Level Tests (parallelisiert über Gene für Effizienz)
  library(lme4)
  library(lmerTest)
  library(broom.mixed)

  message("\n--- Einzelgen-Tests laufen (kann mehrere Minuten dauern) ---")

  # Container für Ergebnisse
  gene_clinical_results <- list()

  # Funktion: Test für ein Gen × eine klinische Variable
  test_gene_clinical <- function(gene_id, gene_expr, clinical_var, clin_data) {

    # Merge Expression + Klinische Daten
    test_data <- data.frame(
      sample_id = names(gene_expr),
      gene_expr = gene_expr,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    test_data <- merge(test_data, clin_data, by = "sample_id", all.x = FALSE)

    # Entferne NA in timepoint/pid
    test_data <- test_data[!is.na(test_data$timepoint) & !is.na(test_data$pid), ]

    # Variable Name (mit _z suffix falls standardisiert)
    var_name <- if (paste0(clinical_var, "_z") %in% names(test_data)) {
      paste0(clinical_var, "_z")
    } else {
      clinical_var
    }

    # Prüfe ob Variable existiert
    if (!var_name %in% names(test_data)) return(NULL)

    # Vollständige Fälle (explizit ohne dplyr NSE)
    complete_cases <- !is.na(test_data[[var_name]]) & !is.na(test_data$gene_expr)
    test_data <- test_data[complete_cases, ]

    # Mindestens 30 Samples erforderlich
    if (nrow(test_data) < 30) return(NULL)

    # LMM - verwende explizite data.frame column references
    tryCatch({

      # Baue Daten-Frame für Modell (nur benötigte Spalten)
      model_data <- data.frame(
        gene_expr = test_data$gene_expr,
        timepoint = test_data$timepoint,
        pid = test_data$pid,
        clinical_predictor = test_data[[var_name]],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )

      # Fit Modell mit fixem Variablennamen
      model <- lmer(gene_expr ~ timepoint + clinical_predictor + (1|pid),
                    data = model_data,
                    REML = TRUE)

      # Koeffizienten extrahieren
      coefs <- broom.mixed::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE)
      coefs_clin <- coefs[coefs$effect == "fixed" & coefs$term == "clinical_predictor", ]

      if (nrow(coefs_clin) == 0) return(NULL)

      # Rückgabe
      data.frame(
        gene_id = gene_id,
        clinical_var = clinical_var,
        estimate = coefs_clin$estimate,
        std.error = coefs_clin$std.error,
        statistic = coefs_clin$statistic,
        p.value = coefs_clin$p.value,
        conf.low = coefs_clin$conf.low,
        conf.high = coefs_clin$conf.high,
        n_samples = nrow(model_data),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )

    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  }

  # Loop über klinische Variablen (pro Variable FDR-Korrektur)
  for (clin_var in available_clinical) {

    message(sprintf("\n  Testing: %s (%d/%d)",
                    clin_var,
                    which(available_clinical == clin_var),
                    length(available_clinical)))

    # Teste alle hochvariablen Gene gegen diese Variable
    results_per_var <- lapply(top_var_genes, function(gene_id) {
      test_gene_clinical(gene_id, vst_hvg[gene_id, ], clin_var, clinical_screening_data)
    }) %>%
      bind_rows()

    if (is.null(results_per_var) || nrow(results_per_var) == 0) {
      message(sprintf("    → Keine Ergebnisse für %s", clin_var))
      next
    }

    # FDR-Korrektur über alle Gene für diese Variable
    results_per_var$p_adj <- p.adjust(results_per_var$p.value, method = "BH")

    # Speichere Ergebnisse
    gene_clinical_results[[clin_var]] <- results_per_var

    # Log Summary
    n_fdr <- sum(results_per_var$p_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_nom <- sum(results_per_var$p.value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
    message(sprintf("    → Tests: %d, FDR<0.05: %d, nominal<0.05: %d",
                    nrow(results_per_var), n_fdr, n_nom))
  }

  # 6. Kombiniere alle Ergebnisse
  gene_clinical_all <- bind_rows(gene_clinical_results) %>%
    arrange(clinical_var, p_adj)

  message(sprintf("\n✓ Alle Tests abgeschlossen: %d Gen-Klinik-Assoziationen",
                  nrow(gene_clinical_all)))

  # 7. Export: Vollständige Ergebnisse
  write.csv(
    gene_clinical_all,
    file.path(clinical_output_dir, "step11b2_single_gene_clinical_all.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  message("✓ Gespeichert: step11b2_single_gene_clinical_all.csv")

  # 8. Export: Top-Hits (FDR < 0.1 ODER Top 50 pro Variable)
  gene_clinical_top <- gene_clinical_all %>%
    group_by(clinical_var) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
    filter(p_adj < 0.1 | rank <= 50) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(clinical_var, p_adj)

  write.csv(
    gene_clinical_top,
    file.path(clinical_output_dir, "step11b2_single_gene_clinical_top_hits.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  message(sprintf("✓ Gespeichert: step11b2_single_gene_clinical_top_hits.csv (%d Hits)",
                  nrow(gene_clinical_top)))

  # 9. Zusammenfassung: FDR-signifikante Befunde
  fdr_sig_summary <- gene_clinical_all %>%
    filter(p_adj < 0.05) %>%
    group_by(clinical_var) %>%
    summarise(
      n_genes_fdr = n(),
      top_gene = gene_id[which.min(p_adj)],
      min_fdr = min(p_adj),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  if (nrow(fdr_sig_summary) > 0) {
    message("\n--- FDR-signifikante Gen-Assoziationen (FDR < 0.05) ---")
    print(fdr_sig_summary)
  } else {
    message("\n⚠️ Keine FDR-signifikanten Gen-Assoziationen (FDR < 0.05)")
  }

  # 10. Visualisierung: Heatmap (Top N Gene × Klinische Variablen, signierte -log10 p)

  # Pivot: Gene × Clinical Variables (p-Werte)
  top_n_per_var <- 10  # Top 10 Gene pro Variable

  top_genes_per_var <- gene_clinical_all %>%
    group_by(clinical_var) %>%
    arrange(p.value) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n_per_var) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Unique Top-Gene
  unique_top_genes <- unique(top_genes_per_var$gene_id)

  message(sprintf("\n--- Heatmap: Top %d Gene pro Variable (%d unique Gene) ---",
                  top_n_per_var, length(unique_top_genes)))

  # Matrix: Genes × Clinical Variables (signierte -log10 p)
  heatmap_data <- gene_clinical_all %>%
    filter(gene_id %in% unique_top_genes) %>%
    mutate(
      signed_log10p = sign(estimate) * (-log10(p.value)),
      signed_log10p = pmax(pmin(signed_log10p, 10), -10)  # Cap bei ±10
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id, clinical_var, signed_log10p) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = clinical_var, values_from = signed_log10p, values_fill = 0)

  # Convert to matrix
  heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(heatmap_data[, -1])
  rownames(heatmap_mat) <- heatmap_data$gene_id

  # Plot
  library(pheatmap)

  pdf(file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "step11b2_single_gene_clinical_heatmap.pdf"),
      width = 8, height = 12)

  pheatmap(
    heatmap_mat,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    show_rownames = nrow(heatmap_mat) <= 100,  # Nur bei wenigen Genen
    color = colorRampPalette(c("blue3", "white", "red3"))(100),
    breaks = seq(-10, 10, length.out = 101),
    main = sprintf("Einzelgen × Klinische Variablen (Top %d/Variable)", top_n_per_var),
    fontsize = 9,
    fontsize_row = 7,
    angle_col = 45
  )

  dev.off()
  message("✓ Heatmap gespeichert: step11b2_single_gene_clinical_heatmap.pdf")

  # 11. Visualisierung: Volcano Plots (Top 3 klinische Variablen mit meisten Hits)

  top_3_vars <- fdr_sig_summary %>%
    arrange(desc(n_genes_fdr)) %>%
    head(3) %>%
    pull(clinical_var)

  if (length(top_3_vars) == 0) {
    # Falls keine FDR-Hits: nimm Variablen mit meisten nominellen Hits
    top_3_vars <- gene_clinical_all %>%
      filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
      group_by(clinical_var) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(n)) %>%
      head(3) %>%
      pull(clinical_var)
  }

  if (length(top_3_vars) > 0) {

    message(sprintf("\n--- Volcano Plots für Top %d Variablen ---", length(top_3_vars)))

    pdf(file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "step11b2_single_gene_clinical_volcano.pdf"),
        width = 14, height = 5)

    par(mfrow = c(1, length(top_3_vars)))

    for (plot_var in top_3_vars) {

      var_data <- gene_clinical_all %>% filter(clinical_var == plot_var)

      # Volcano Plot
      plot(
        var_data$estimate,
        -log10(var_data$p.value),
        pch = 20,
        col = ifelse(var_data$p_adj < 0.05, "red",
                     ifelse(var_data$p.value < 0.05, "orange", "grey70")),
        xlab = "Effekt (β)",
        ylab = "-log10(p-value)",
        main = paste0(plot_var, "\n(", sum(var_data$p_adj < 0.05), " FDR<0.05, ",
                      sum(var_data$p.value < 0.05), " nom<0.05)"),
        cex = 0.5
      )

      # Threshold-Linien
      abline(h = -log10(0.05), lty = 2, col = "grey50")
      abline(v = 0, lty = 1, col = "grey30")

      # Legende
      legend("topright",
             legend = c("FDR<0.05", "p<0.05", "n.s."),
             col = c("red", "orange", "grey70"),
             pch = 20,
             cex = 0.7,
             bty = "n")
    }

    dev.off()
    message("✓ Volcano Plots gespeichert: step11b2_single_gene_clinical_volcano.pdf")
  }

  message("\n✓ 11b2: Einzelgen-Klinik-Assoziation abgeschlossen")

} else {
  message("\n⚠️ 11b2: VST-Matrix oder Sample-Metadaten nicht verfügbar — übersprungen")
}

# Cleanup: Entferne eventuelle var-Objekte (falls durch Fehler erstellt)
if (exists("var", inherits = FALSE)) rm(var)
```

## 11c: Follow-up — PEROXISOME × Geschlecht (FDR-signifikanter Befund)

**Befund:** Von 400 GSVA-Tests war **HALLMARK_PEROXISOME × sex** der einzige FDR-korrigierte signifikante Treffer (β = –0.083, FDR = 0.048).

**Biologischer Kontext:**
Peroxisomen sind zentral für den Lipid-Metabolismus (sehr langkettige Fettsäuren, Plasmalogen-Biosynthese) und zeigen dokumentierte Geschlechtsunterschiede (Lodhi & Semenkovich 2014, Cell Metab).

**Ziel dieser Follow-up-Analyse:**
1. Effektgröße quantifizieren (Cohen's d)
2. Trajektorien visualisieren (Konstanz über Zeit prüfen)
3. Gene-level Treiber identifizieren
4. Sensitivität nach Adjustierung für Age/BMI

```{r}
#| label: step11c-followup-peroxisome-effect-size
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("========================================")
message("11c: Follow-up PEROXISOME × Geschlecht")
message("========================================\n")

# ============================================================
# A) Effektgröße & deskriptive Statistik
# ============================================================

message("--- A) Effektgröße (Cohen's d) ---\n")

# Lade GSVA-Matrix
gsva_hallmark_full_path <- "../../../res/cache/gsva_hallmark_scores.rds"
if (!file.exists(gsva_hallmark_full_path)) {
  stop("❌ GSVA-Cache nicht gefunden: ", gsva_hallmark_full_path)
}
gsva_full <- readRDS(gsva_hallmark_full_path)

# Extrahiere Peroxisom-Score
perox_score <- gsva_full["HALLMARK_PEROXISOME", ]

# Merge mit klinischen Daten
perox_data <- data.frame(
  sample_id = names(perox_score),
  perox_gsva = as.numeric(perox_score),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  inner_join(
    sample_meta_clinical %>%
      dplyr::select(sample_id, pid, timepoint, sex, age, any_of("bmi")),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sex), !is.na(perox_gsva))

perox_data$timepoint <- factor(perox_data$timepoint, levels = c("A", "V1", "V2"))

message(sprintf("Daten: %d Samples, %d Patienten",
                nrow(perox_data), n_distinct(perox_data$pid)))

# Deskriptive Statistik nach Geschlecht (gepooled über Timepoints)
perox_summary <- perox_data %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_patients = n_distinct(pid),
    mean_perox = mean(perox_gsva, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_perox = sd(perox_gsva, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_perox = median(perox_gsva, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(perox_gsva, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(perox_gsva, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

message("Deskriptive Statistik (Peroxisom-Score nach Geschlecht):")
safe_print(perox_summary)

# Cohen's d (Effektgröße)
perox_male <- perox_data %>% filter(sex == "male") %>% pull(perox_gsva)
perox_female <- perox_data %>% filter(sex == "female") %>% pull(perox_gsva)

cohens_d_result <- effectsize::cohens_d(perox_male, perox_female)

message(sprintf("\nCohen's d (male vs female): %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f]",
                cohens_d_result$Cohens_d,
                cohens_d_result$CI_low,
                cohens_d_result$CI_high))

# Interpretation nach Cohen (1988)
d_abs <- abs(cohens_d_result$Cohens_d)
if (d_abs < 0.2) {
  d_interp <- "klein (|d| < 0.2)"
} else if (d_abs < 0.5) {
  d_interp <- "klein bis mittel (0.2 ≤ |d| < 0.5)"
} else if (d_abs < 0.8) {
  d_interp <- "mittel (0.5 ≤ |d| < 0.8)"
} else {
  d_interp <- "groß (|d| ≥ 0.8)"
}
message(sprintf("  → Effektgröße: %s", d_interp))

# Export
write.csv(
  perox_summary,
  file.path(clinical_output_dir, "step11c_peroxisome_sex_descriptives.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
message("\n✓ Gespeichert: step11c_peroxisome_sex_descriptives.csv")
```

```{r}
# Aggregiere zu Mittelwert ± SE pro Timepoint × Sex

  group_by(timepoint, sex) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_perox = mean(perox_gsva, na.rm = TRUE),

    se_perox = sd_perox / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

message("Trajektorien-Daten:")
safe_print(perox_traj)

# Plot: Linien mit Fehlerbalken
library(ggplot2)

p_perox_traj <- ggplot(perox_traj, aes(x = timepoint, y = mean_perox,
                                        group = sex, color = sex)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_perox - se_perox,
                    ymax = mean_perox + se_perox),
                width = 0.15, size = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("male" = "#2166AC", "female" = "#B2182B"),
    labels = c("male" = "Männer", "female" = "Frauen")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "HALLMARK_PEROXISOME × Geschlecht",
    subtitle = "Mittelwert ± SE pro Zeitpunkt (FDR = 0.048)",
    x = "Zeitpunkt",
    y = "GSVA-Score (Peroxisom-Aktivität)",
    color = "Geschlecht"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey30")
  )

traj_file <- file.path(clinical_fig_dir, "step11c_peroxisome_sex_trajectories.png")
ggsave(traj_file, p_perox_traj, width = 7, height = 5.5, dpi = 150)

message("✓ Trajektorien-Plot gespeichert: ", basename(traj_file))

# Interpretation
male_range <- perox_traj %>% filter(sex == "male") %>% pull(mean_perox) %>% range()
female_range <- perox_traj %>% filter(sex == "female") %>% pull(mean_perox) %>% range()
lines_parallel <- all(perox_traj %>%
                      group_by(timepoint) %>%
                      summarise(diff = diff(mean_perox)) %>%
                      pull(diff) %>%
                      abs() %>%
                      diff() %>%
                      abs() < 0.02)

if (lines_parallel) {
  message("  → Linien verlaufen parallel → Geschlechtsunterschied ist zeitkonstant")
} else {
  message("  → Linien nicht parallel → mögliche Interaktion mit Zeitverlauf")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: step11c-followup-peroxisome-gene-level
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("\n--- C) Gene-level Treiber identifizieren ---\n")

# Lade Peroxisom-Geneset
library(msigdbr)
perox_genes <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>%
  filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_PEROXISOME") %>%
  pull(gene_symbol) %>%
  unique()

message(sprintf("HALLMARK_PEROXISOME: %d Gene im MSigDB", length(perox_genes)))

# VST-Matrix laden (aus 11b, oder neu)
if (!exists("vst_mat")) {
  vst_candidates <- c(
    "../../../res/cache/vst_blind_TRUE.rds",
    list.files("../../../res/cache", pattern = "^vst_blind_TRUE.*\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
  )
  vst_candidates <- unique(vst_candidates[file.exists(vst_candidates)])

  if (length(vst_candidates) == 0) {
    message("⚠️ VST-Matrix nicht verfügbar — Gene-level-Analyse übersprungen")
    vst_available_gene <- FALSE
  } else {
    vst_obj <- readRDS(vst_candidates[length(vst_candidates)])
    if (inherits(vst_obj, "SummarizedExperiment") || inherits(vst_obj, "DESeqTransform")) {
      vst_mat <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(vst_obj)
    } else if (is.matrix(vst_obj)) {
      vst_mat <- vst_obj
    } else {
      stop("❌ Unerwartetes VST-Format")
    }
    vst_available_gene <- TRUE
  }
} else {
  vst_available_gene <- TRUE
}

if (vst_available_gene) {

  # VST-Matrix nutzt Ensembl-IDs → Mapping nötig
  # Rownames: z.B. "ENSG00000000003.16"
  # Entferne Versionsnummern für Mapping
  vst_ensembl <- gsub("\\..*$", "", rownames(vst_mat))
  names(vst_ensembl) <- rownames(vst_mat)

  # Mapping: Ensembl → Gene Symbol via org.Hs.eg.db
  ensembl_to_symbol <- tryCatch({
    suppressMessages(
      AnnotationDbi::select(
        org.Hs.eg.db,
        keys = unique(vst_ensembl),
        columns = c("SYMBOL"),
        keytype = "ENSEMBL"
      )
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("⚠️ Gene-Annotation fehlgeschlagen: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })

  if (is.null(ensembl_to_symbol) || nrow(ensembl_to_symbol) == 0) {
    message("⚠️ Ensembl→Symbol Mapping fehlgeschlagen — Gene-level übersprungen")
    vst_available_gene <- FALSE
  }
}

if (vst_available_gene) {

  # Erstelle Lookup: Gene Symbol → Ensembl-ID (in VST-Matrix)
  symbol_to_vst_row <- data.frame(
    ensembl_id = vst_ensembl,
    vst_row = names(vst_ensembl),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    left_join(ensembl_to_symbol, by = c("ensembl_id" = "ENSEMBL")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(SYMBOL))

  # Finde Peroxisom-Gene in VST (via Symbol-Mapping)
  perox_genes_mapped <- symbol_to_vst_row %>%
    filter(SYMBOL %in% perox_genes)

  message(sprintf("  → %d/%d Gene in VST-Matrix gefunden (via Ensembl-Mapping)",
                  n_distinct(perox_genes_mapped$SYMBOL), length(perox_genes)))

  if (nrow(perox_genes_mapped) < 5) {
    message("⚠️ Zu wenige Peroxisom-Gene verfügbar (<5) — Gene-level übersprungen")
  } else {

    # Extrahiere VST-Werte für diese Gene
    perox_expr <- vst_mat[perox_genes_mapped$vst_row, , drop = FALSE]

    # Behandle duplicate Symbole (falls ein Symbol mehrere Ensembl-IDs hat)
    # → Nimm Median pro Symbol über duplicate IDs
    if (any(duplicated(perox_genes_mapped$SYMBOL))) {
      message(sprintf("  ⚠️ %d duplicate Gene-Symbole → Median über Ensembl-IDs berechnet",
                      sum(duplicated(perox_genes_mapped$SYMBOL))))

      perox_expr_agg <- lapply(unique(perox_genes_mapped$SYMBOL), function(sym) {
        rows <- perox_genes_mapped$vst_row[perox_genes_mapped$SYMBOL == sym]
        if (length(rows) == 1) {
          perox_expr[rows, ]
        } else {
          # Median über Zeilen (Gene mit gleichem Symbol)
          apply(perox_expr[rows, , drop = FALSE], 2, median, na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      })
      perox_expr <- do.call(rbind, perox_expr_agg)
      rownames(perox_expr) <- unique(perox_genes_mapped$SYMBOL)
    } else {
      rownames(perox_expr) <- perox_genes_mapped$SYMBOL
    }

    message(sprintf("  → %d unique Gene für Tests verfügbar", nrow(perox_expr)))

    # Gene-level Tests: male vs female (t-Test, gepooled über Timepoints)
    perox_gene_tests <- lapply(rownames(perox_expr), function(gene) {

      gene_data <- data.frame(
        sample_id = colnames(perox_expr),
        expr = perox_expr[gene, ],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ) %>%
        inner_join(
          sample_meta_clinical %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, sex),
          by = "sample_id"
        ) %>%
        filter(!is.na(sex), !is.na(expr))

      # t-Test
      test_res <- tryCatch(
        t.test(expr ~ sex, data = gene_data),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      if (is.null(test_res)) return(NULL)

      tibble(
        gene = gene,
        mean_male = mean(gene_data$expr[gene_data$sex == "male"], na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_female = mean(gene_data$expr[gene_data$sex == "female"], na.rm = TRUE),
        diff = mean_male - mean_female,
        t_stat = test_res$statistic,
        p_value = test_res$p.value,
        n_male = sum(gene_data$sex == "male"),
        n_female = sum(gene_data$sex == "female")
      )
    }) %>%
      bind_rows()

    # FDR-Korrektur über alle Peroxisom-Gene
    perox_gene_tests$p_adj <- p.adjust(perox_gene_tests$p_value, method = "BH")

    # Sortiere nach adjustiertem p-Wert
    perox_gene_tests <- perox_gene_tests %>%
      arrange(p_adj)

    # Top-10 Treiber
    perox_top_drivers <- perox_gene_tests %>%
      head(10)

    message("Top-10 Gene mit stärkstem Geschlechtsunterschied (Peroxisom-Pathway):")
    safe_print(perox_top_drivers[, c("gene", "diff", "p_value", "p_adj")])

    # Export
    write.csv(
      perox_gene_tests,
      file.path(clinical_output_dir, "step11c_peroxisome_gene_level_sex.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    message("\n✓ Gespeichert: step11c_peroxisome_gene_level_sex.csv")

    # Zusammenfassung
    n_sig_genes <- sum(perox_gene_tests$p_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
    message(sprintf("  → %d/%d Gene FDR < 0.05 (Geschlechtsunterschied)",
                    n_sig_genes, nrow(perox_gene_tests)))

    if (n_sig_genes > 0) {
      sig_genes <- perox_gene_tests %>%
        filter(p_adj < 0.05) %>%
        pull(gene)
      message(sprintf("  → Signifikante Gene: %s", paste(sig_genes, collapse = ", ")))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: step11c-followup-peroxisome-sensitivity
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

message("\n--- D) Sensitivitätsanalyse: Adjustierung für Age/BMI ---\n")

# Prüfe, ob Sex-Effekt nach Kontrolle für Age (und optional BMI) bestehen bleibt

# Bereite Daten vor (vollständige Fälle mit Age)
perox_sens <- perox_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(sex), !is.na(perox_gsva))

# Optional: BMI hinzufügen (falls verfügbar)
has_bmi <- "bmi" %in% names(perox_sens)
if (has_bmi) {
  perox_sens <- perox_sens %>%
    filter(!is.na(bmi)) %>%
    mutate(bmi_z = as.numeric(scale(bmi)))
  message(sprintf("Sensitivitäts-Daten: %d Samples (mit Age + BMI)", nrow(perox_sens)))
} else {
  message(sprintf("Sensitivitäts-Daten: %d Samples (mit Age, BMI nicht verfügbar)", nrow(perox_sens)))
}

if (nrow(perox_sens) < 30) {
  message("⚠️ SKIPPED: Zu wenige Samples für Sensitivitätsanalyse (n < 30)")
} else {

  # Modell 1: Mit Sex + Age (+ BMI falls verfügbar)
  if (has_bmi) {
    formula_full <- as.formula("perox_gsva ~ timepoint + sex + age + bmi_z + (1|pid)")
    model_with_sex <- lmerTest::lmer(formula_full, data = perox_sens, REML = TRUE)
    covar_str <- "Age + BMI"
  } else {
    formula_full <- as.formula("perox_gsva ~ timepoint + sex + age + (1|pid)")
    model_with_sex <- lmerTest::lmer(formula_full, data = perox_sens, REML = TRUE)
    covar_str <- "Age"
  }

  # Modell 2: Ohne Sex (nur Confounders)
  if (has_bmi) {
    formula_reduced <- as.formula("perox_gsva ~ timepoint + age + bmi_z + (1|pid)")
  } else {
    formula_reduced <- as.formula("perox_gsva ~ timepoint + age + (1|pid)")
  }
  model_without_sex <- lmerTest::lmer(formula_reduced, data = perox_sens, REML = TRUE)

  # Likelihood-Ratio-Test
  lr_test <- anova(model_without_sex, model_with_sex)

  message(sprintf("Likelihood-Ratio-Test: Sex-Effekt nach Adjustierung für %s", covar_str))
  message(sprintf("  Chi² = %.3f, df = %d, p = %.4f",
                  lr_test$Chisq[2], lr_test$Df[2], lr_test$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]))

  # Koeffizienten des vollen Modells
  coef_full <- broom.mixed::tidy(model_with_sex, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(effect == "fixed", grepl("sex", term))

  if (nrow(coef_full) > 0) {
    message(sprintf("\nSex-Koeffizient (adjustiert für %s):", covar_str))
    message(sprintf("  β = %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f], p = %.4f",
                    coef_full$estimate, coef_full$conf.low,
                    coef_full$conf.high, coef_full$p.value))

    # Vergleich mit univariatem Effekt (aus 11a)
    univariate_beta <- -0.083  # Aus Haupt-GSVA-Screening
    beta_change_pct <- 100 * (coef_full$estimate - univariate_beta) / abs(univariate_beta)

    message(sprintf("  → Veränderung vs. univariat (β = %.3f): %.1f%%",
                    univariate_beta, beta_change_pct))

    if (abs(beta_change_pct) < 10) {
      message("    Interpretation: Effekt stabil, unabhängig von Confoundern")
    } else if (abs(beta_change_pct) < 30) {
      message("    Interpretation: Moderate Abschwächung, partielle Mediation möglich")
    } else {
      message("    Interpretation: Starke Abschwächung, Confounder-Effekt wahrscheinlich")
    }
  }

  # Export Sensitivitätsergebnisse
  sens_summary <- tibble(
    model = c("Univariat (aus 11a)", sprintf("Adjustiert (%s)", covar_str)),
    beta = c(univariate_beta, coef_full$estimate),
    conf_low = c(-0.1303415, coef_full$conf.low),
    conf_high = c(-0.03561698, coef_full$conf.high),
    p_value = c(0.0009691508, coef_full$p.value),
    n_samples = c(nrow(perox_data), nrow(perox_sens))
  )

  write.csv(
    sens_summary,
    file.path(clinical_output_dir, "step11c_peroxisome_sex_sensitivity.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  message("\n✓ Gespeichert: step11c_peroxisome_sex_sensitivity.csv")
}

message("\n✓ 11c: Follow-up PEROXISOME × Geschlecht abgeschlossen")
```
